original_english: Living organisms are well-organised structures; they can have tissues, tissues have cells, cells have smaller components in them.
hinglish_roman: Living organisms bahut well-organised structures hote hain; unme tissues ho sakte hain, tissues mein cells hote hain, aur cells mein smaller components hote hain.

original_english: The processes which together perform the maintenance job are called life processes.
hinglish_roman: Jo processes milke maintenance ka kaam karte hain, unhe life processes kehte hain.

original_english: Energy is needed for maintenance processes; this energy comes from outside the body of the individual organism.
hinglish_roman: Maintenance processes ke liye energy chahiye hoti hai; yeh energy organism ke body ke bahar se aati hai.

original_english: Autotrophs include green plants and some bacteria that use simple food material from inorganic sources.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs mein green plants aur kuch bacteria aate hain jo inorganic sources se simple food material use karte hain.

original_english: Photosynthesis is the process by which autotrophs take in substances from the outside and convert them into stored forms of energy.
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis woh process hai jiske zariye autotrophs bahar se substances lete hain aur unhe stored energy ke form mein convert karte hain.

original_english: Carbon dioxide and water are converted into carbohydrates in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll.
hinglish_roman: Carbon dioxide aur water, sunlight aur chlorophyll ki presence mein carbohydrates mein convert ho jaate hain.

original_english: Stomata are tiny pores present on the surface of the leaves through which massive amounts of gaseous exchange takes place.
hinglish_roman: Stomata patti ki surface par maujood tiny pores hote hain jinke zariye badi matra mein gaseous exchange hoti hai.

original_english: The opening and closing of the stomatal pore is a function of the guard cells.
hinglish_roman: Stomatal pore ka kholna aur band hona guard cells ka kaam hota hai.

original_english: Heterotrophic organisms include animals and fungi which utilise complex substances broken down by enzymes.
hinglish_roman: Heterotrophic organisms mein animals aur fungi aate hain jo enzymes dwara todi gayi complex substances ka upyog karte hain.

original_english: Amoeba takes in food using temporary finger-like extensions of the cell surface which fuse over the food particle forming a food-vacuole.
hinglish_roman: Amoeba apni cell surface ke temporary finger-jaisi extensions se khaana leta hai jo food particle ke upar fuse hokar ek food-vacuole banati hain.

original_english: Saliva contains an enzyme called salivary amylase that breaks down starch into simple sugar.
hinglish_roman: Saliva mein salivary amylase naam ka ek enzyme hota hai jo starch ko simple sugar mein tod deta hai.

original_english: The food is mixed thoroughly with saliva and moved around the mouth while chewing by the muscular tongue.
hinglish_roman: Khaana saliva ke saath achhi tarah mix hota hai aur chewing ke dauran muscular tongue dwara mooh mein ghumaya jaata hai.

original_english: Peristaltic movements occur all along the gut to push food forward in a regulated manner.
hinglish_roman: Peristaltic movements poori gut mein hoti hain jo khaane ko regulate karke aage dhakela karti hain.

original_english: Gastric glands in the stomach release hydrochloric acid, pepsin, and mucus.
hinglish_roman: Stomach ki wall mein maujood gastric glands hydrochloric acid, pepsin, aur mucus release karti hain.

original_english: The small intestine is the site of complete digestion of carbohydrates, proteins and fats.
hinglish_roman: Small intestine woh jagah hai jahan carbohydrates, proteins aur fats ka poora digestion hota hai.

original_english: Bile juice from the liver acts on fats, breaking them into smaller globules to increase the efficiency of enzyme action.
hinglish_roman: Liver se aane wala bile juice fats par kaam karta hai, unhe chhote globules mein tod ke enzyme action ki efficiency badhata hai.

original_english: Villi are finger-like projections on the inner lining of the small intestine that increase the surface area for absorption.
hinglish_roman: Villi small intestine ki inner lining par finger-jaisi projections hain jo absorption ke liye surface area badhati hain.

original_english: The large intestine absorbs more water from the undigested food before it is excreted through the anus.
hinglish_roman: Large intestine undigested khaane se zyada paani absorb karta hai usse anus ke zariye bahar nikalne se pehle.

original_english: The first step of respiration is the break-down of glucose, a six-carbon molecule, into a three-carbon molecule called pyruvate in the cytoplasm.
hinglish_roman: Respiration ka pehla step cytoplasm mein glucose ka, jo ek six-carbon molecule hai, teen-carbon molecule jise pyruvate kehte hain mein tutna hai.

original_english: Anaerobic respiration takes place in the absence of oxygen, converting pyruvate into ethanol and carbon dioxide in yeast.
hinglish_roman: Anaerobic respiration oxygen ki absence mein hoti hai, yeast mein pyruvate ko ethanol aur carbon dioxide mein convert karti hai.

original_english: Aerobic respiration breaks pyruvate in the mitochondria using oxygen to give carbon dioxide, water and energy.
hinglish_roman: Aerobic respiration mitochondria mein oxygen ki madad se pyruvate ko carbon dioxide, paani aur energy mein todti hai.

original_english: The build-up of lactic acid in muscles during sudden activity causes cramps.
hinglish_roman: Achanak activity ke dauran muscles mein lactic acid ka jama hona cramps ka kaaran banta hai.

original_english: ATP is the energy currency for most cellular processes and is synthesised using energy released during respiration.
hinglish_roman: ATP zyaadatar cellular processes ke liye energy currency hai aur respiration ke dauran nikli energy se synthesise hota hai.

original_english: Since the amount of dissolved oxygen in water is less, aquatic organisms breathe at a much faster rate than terrestrial organisms.
hinglish_roman: Kyunki paani mein dissolved oxygen ki matra kam hoti hai, aquatic organisms terrestrial organisms se kaafi tezi se saanste hain.

original_english: In human beings, air is taken into the body through the nostrils, filtered by fine hairs, and passed through the throat into the lungs.
hinglish_roman: Insano mein, hawaain naak ke zariye body mein aati hain, barik baalon se filter hoti hain, aur galey se hote hue lungs mein pahunchti hain.

original_english: The alveoli provide a surface where the exchange of gases can take place and have an extensive network of blood vessels.
hinglish_roman: Alveoli ek aisi surface provide karti hain jahan gases ka exchange hota hai aur inme blood vessels ka ek bada network hota hai.

original_english: Haemoglobin is the respiratory pigment in human beings that has a very high affinity for oxygen and is present in red blood corpuscles.
hinglish_roman: Haemoglobin insano mein respiratory pigment hai jisko oxygen se bahut zyada affinity hoti hai aur yeh red blood corpuscles mein hota hai.

original_english: Blood consists of a fluid medium called plasma in which the cells are suspended.
hinglish_roman: Blood mein plasma naam ka ek fluid medium hota hai jisme cells suspend rehte hain.

original_english: The heart has different chambers to prevent oxygen-rich blood from mixing with blood containing carbon dioxide.
hinglish_roman: Heart mein alag alag chambers hote hain taaki oxygen-rich blood, carbon dioxide wale blood se mix na ho sake.

original_english: The left atrium collects oxygen-rich blood from the lungs and transfers it to the left ventricle which pumps it to the body.
hinglish_roman: Left atrium lungs se oxygen-rich blood collect karta hai aur use left ventricle mein transfer karta hai jo use poore body mein pump karta hai.

original_english: Double circulation means blood passes through the heart twice during each cycle of passage through the body.
hinglish_roman: Double circulation ka matlab hai ki blood body mein ek chakkar lagane mein heart se do baar guzarta hai.

original_english: Arteries are thick-walled elastic vessels that carry blood away from the heart under high pressure.
hinglish_roman: Arteries thick-walled elastic naaliyan hoti hain jo blood ko heart se zyada pressure mein dur le jaati hain.

original_english: Veins have valves that ensure blood flows only in one direction back to the heart.
hinglish_roman: Veins mein valves hote hain jo ensure karte hain ki blood sirf ek hi direction mein heart ki taraf bahta rahe.

original_english: Capillaries are the smallest blood vessels with one-cell thick walls across which exchange of material between blood and cells occurs.
hinglish_roman: Capillaries sabse chhhoti blood vessels hoti hain jinki walls ek cell ki moti hoti hain aur jinke zariye blood aur cells ke beech material ka exchange hota hai.

original_english: Platelets are blood cells that help clot blood at points of injury to minimise blood loss.
hinglish_roman: Platelets blood cells hote hain jo injury wali jagah par blood ko clot karne mein madad karte hain taaki blood loss kam ho.

original_english: Lymph carries digested and absorbed fat from the intestine and drains excess fluid from extra cellular space back into the blood.
hinglish_roman: Lymph intestine se digested aur absorbed fat le jaata hai aur extra cellular space se zyada fluid ko wapas blood mein drain karta hai.

original_english: Plants have two transport systems: xylem moves water and minerals from soil, while phloem transports food from leaves.
hinglish_roman: Plants mein do transport systems hote hain: xylem mitti se paani aur minerals le jaata hai, jabki phloem patti se khaana transport karta hai.

original_english: Roots actively take up ions from the soil, creating a concentration difference that causes water to move into root xylem.
hinglish_roman: Jadein mitti se ions actively absorb karti hain, ek concentration difference create karke jo paani ko root xylem mein jaane par majboor karta hai.

original_english: Transpiration is the loss of water in the form of vapour from the aerial parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Transpiration plant ke upar wale hisson se paani ka vapour ke roop mein khojaana hai.

original_english: Translocation of food occurs in the phloem using energy from ATP, increasing osmotic pressure to move material.
hinglish_roman: Khaane ka translocation phloem mein ATP ki energy use karke hota hai, jo osmotic pressure badhata hai aur material ko move karta hai.

original_english: Excretion is the biological process involved in the removal of harmful metabolic wastes from the body.
hinglish_roman: Excretion woh biological process hai jisme body se haanikaarak metabolic wastes nikale jaate hain.

original_english: The human excretory system includes a pair of kidneys, ureters, a urinary bladder and a urethra.
hinglish_roman: Insani excretory system mein ek jodi kidneys, ureters, ek urinary bladder aur ek urethra hoti hai.

original_english: Urine is produced in the kidneys to filter out waste products like urea and uric acid from the blood.
hinglish_roman: Urine kidneys mein banta hai taaki blood se urea aur uric acid jaisi waste products filter out ho sakein.

original_english: Each kidney has a large number of filtration units called nephrons packed close together.
hinglish_roman: Har kidney mein bahut saari filtration units hoti hain jinhe nephrons kehte hain jo ek saath close pack hoti hain.

original_english: Glucose, amino acids, salts and water are selectively reabsorbed as urine flows along the kidney tubule.
hinglish_roman: Glucose, amino acids, salts aur paani selectively reabsorb ho jaate hain jab urine kidney tubule se guzarti hai.

original_english: An artificial kidney removes nitrogenous waste products from the blood through the process of dialysis.
hinglish_roman: Artificial kidney dialysis ki process ke zariye blood se nitrogenous waste products hatati hai.

original_english: Plants can get rid of excess water through transpiration and some waste products are stored in cell vacuoles.
hinglish_roman: Plants transpiration ke zariye zyada paani se chhutkaara pa sakti hain aur kuch waste products cell vacuoles mein store hoti hain.

original_english: Some plant waste products are stored as resins and gums in old xylem, while others are excreted into the surrounding soil.
hinglish_roman: Kuch plant waste products purane xylem mein resins aur gums ke roop mein store hote hain, jabki kuch aas paas ki mitti mein excrete ho jaate hain.

original_english: Viruses do not show any molecular movement until they infect a cell, which is partly why there is controversy about whether they are alive.
hinglish_roman: Viruses kisi cell ko infect karne tak koi molecular movement nahi dikhate, isliye yeh controversy hai ki woh sach mein alive hain ya nahi.

original_english: Single-celled organisms do not need specific organs for taking in food or exchanging gases because their entire surface is in contact with the environment.
hinglish_roman: Single-celled organisms ko khaana lene ya gases exchange karne ke liye alag organs ki zaroorat nahi kyunki unki puri surface environment ke sampark mein hoti hai.

original_english: The pancreas secretes pancreatic juice containing enzymes like trypsin for proteins and lipase for fats.
hinglish_roman: Pancreas pancreatic juice secrete karta hai jisme trypsin jaisi enzymes proteins ke liye aur lipase fats ke liye hoti hain.

original_english: Blood pressure is the force that blood exerts against the wall of a vessel and is measured using a sphygmomanometer.
hinglish_roman: Blood pressure woh force hai jo blood vessel ki wall ke khilaf lagata hai aur ise sphygmomanometer se measure kiya jaata hai.

original_english: Normal systolic pressure is about 120 mm of Hg and diastolic pressure is 80 mm of Hg.
hinglish_roman: Normal systolic pressure lagbhag 120 mm Hg hota hai aur diastolic pressure 80 mm Hg hota hai.

original_english: Hypertension is caused by constriction of arterioles, increasing resistance to blood flow and can lead to rupture of an artery.
hinglish_roman: Hypertension arterioles ke sikadte rehne ki wajah se hota hai, blood flow ka resistance badhata hai aur artery ke phatne ka khatra ban jaata hai.

original_english: In fishes, the heart has only two chambers and blood is pumped to the gills where it is oxygenated before going to the body.
hinglish_roman: Machchliyon mein heart mein sirf do chambers hote hain aur blood pehle gills mein pump hota hai jahan oxygenate hota hai phir body mein jaata hai.

original_english: Nitrogen is an essential element for plants, taken up as inorganic nitrates or nitrites, or as organic compounds prepared by bacteria.
hinglish_roman: Nitrogen plants ke liye ek zaroori element hai, jo inorganic nitrates ya nitrites ke roop mein, ya bacteria dwara bane organic compounds ke roop mein liya jaata hai.

original_english: Parasitic nutrition is used by organisms like cuscuta, ticks, lice, leeches and tapeworms that derive nutrition without killing the host.
hinglish_roman: Parasitic nutrition cuscuta, ticks, lice, joonk aur tapeworms jaisi organisms use karti hain jo host ko maare bina nutrition lete hain.

original_english: Herbivores have longer small intestines to digest cellulose, while carnivores have shorter ones because meat is easier to digest.
hinglish_roman: Herbivores ki small intestine lambi hoti hai cellulose digest karne ke liye, jabki carnivores ki chhhoti hoti hai kyunki maas digest karna aasaan hota hai.

original_english: Amphibians and many reptiles have three-chambered hearts and tolerate some mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood.
hinglish_roman: Amphibians aur kaafi reptiles ke teen-chambered heart hote hain aur yeh oxygenated aur deoxygenated blood ke thode mixing ko sahte hain.

original_english: During the day, CO2 generated during respiration is used up for photosynthesis so no CO2 is released.
hinglish_roman: Din ke dauran, respiration mein bana CO2 photosynthesis ke liye istemal ho jaata hai isliye koi CO2 bahar nahi nikalta.

original_english: The mucus in the stomach protects the inner lining from the action of hydrochloric acid under normal conditions.
hinglish_roman: Stomach mein maujood mucus normal conditions mein inner lining ko hydrochloric acid ke asar se bachata hai.

original_english: Transpiration pull becomes the major driving force for movement of water in xylem during the day when stomata are open.
hinglish_roman: Din mein jab stomata khule hote hain, transpiration pull xylem mein paani ke movement ki sabse badi driving force ban jaati hai.

original_english: The sphincter muscle at the exit of the stomach releases food in small amounts into the small intestine.
hinglish_roman: Stomach ke bahar wali jagah par sphincter muscle thodi thodi matra mein khaana small intestine mein release karta hai.

original_english: Carbon dioxide is more soluble in water than oxygen and is mostly transported in dissolved form in blood.
hinglish_roman: Carbon dioxide oxygen se zyada paani mein soluble hoti hai isliye blood mein zyaadatar dissolved form mein transport hoti hai.

original_english: If diffusion were used to move oxygen, it would take 3 years for a molecule to travel from the lungs to the toes.
hinglish_roman: Agar oxygen ke liye diffusion ka use kiya jaata, toh lungs se paon tak pahunchne mein ek molecule ko 3 saal lagte.

original_english: The alveolar surface if spread out would cover about 80 square metres, making gas exchange very efficient.
hinglish_roman: Agar alveolar surface ko failaaya jaaye toh woh lagbhag 80 square metres cover karegi, jisse gas exchange bahut efficient ho jaati hai.

original_english: In spring, sugar stored in root or stem tissue is transported to the buds which need energy to grow.
hinglish_roman: Basant mein, jadon ya tane mein store hue sugar ko buds tak pahunchaya jaata hai jinhe barhne ke liye energy chahiye hoti hai.

original_english: Dental caries begin when bacteria acting on sugars produce acids that soften or demineralise the enamel.
hinglish_roman: Dental caries tab shuru hoti hain jab bacteria sugar par asar karke aise acids banate hain jo enamel ko soft ya demineralise kar dete hain.

original_english: Urine is stored in the urinary bladder until pressure leads to the urge to pass it out through the urethra.
hinglish_roman: Urine urinary bladder mein tab tak store rehti hai jab tak pressure se urethra ke zariye bahar karne ki ichha na ho.

original_english: In a healthy adult, the initial filtrate in the kidneys is about 180 litres daily, but only 1 to 2 litres are actually excreted.
hinglish_roman: Ek healthy adult mein kidneys mein roz lagbhag 180 litre filtrate banta hai, lekin asli mein sirf 1 se 2 litre hi excrete hota hai.

original_english: The guard cells swell when water flows into them, causing the stomatal pore to open.
hinglish_roman: Guard cells mein jab paani jaata hai toh woh phool jaate hain, jisse stomatal pore khul jaata hai.

original_english: Organ donation involves surgically removing an organ from a donor and transplanting it to a recipient whose organ has failed.
hinglish_roman: Organ donation mein ek donor se organ surgically nikala jaata hai aur ek aisi vyakti ko transplant kiya jaata hai jiska organ kaam karna band ho gaya ho.

original_english: Plants use the fact that many of their tissues consist of dead cells and they can even lose parts like leaves to get rid of waste.
hinglish_roman: Plants is baat ka faayda uthate hain ki unke kai tissues dead cells se bane hain aur woh waste se chhutkaara paane ke liye patte jaisi cheezein bhi gira sakte hain.

original_english: The right ventricle pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs for oxygenation after receiving it from the right atrium.
hinglish_roman: Right ventricle right atrium se deoxygenated blood lekar use oxygenation ke liye lungs mein pump karta hai.

original_english: Birds and mammals maintain constant body temperature using energy, which is why they need efficient double circulation.
hinglish_roman: Pakshi aur mammals energy use karke apna body temperature constant rakhte hain, isliye unhe efficient double circulation ki zaroorat hoti hai.

original_english: What is the difference between aerobic and anaerobic respiration?
hinglish_roman: Aerobic aur anaerobic respiration mein kya antar hota hai?

original_english: What is photosynthesis and where does it take place?
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis kya hota hai aur yeh kahan hota hai?

original_english: Why do we need a transport system in our body?
hinglish_roman: Hamare body mein transport system ki zaroorat kyun padti hai?

original_english: Can you give an example of autotrophic nutrition?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap autotrophic nutrition ka ek example de sakte hain?

original_english: What is the role of the kidney in excretion?
hinglish_roman: Excretion mein kidney ka kya role hota hai?

original_english: What is the formula or equation for photosynthesis?
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis ki formula ya equation kya hoti hai?

original_english: How is double circulation different from single circulation?
hinglish_roman: Double circulation aur single circulation mein kya farq hota hai?

original_english: What exactly is a nephron and what does it do?
hinglish_roman: Nephron actually hota kya hai aur yeh kya karta hai?

original_english: Can you explain how xylem is different from phloem?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap explain kar sakte hain ki xylem aur phloem mein kya difference hai?

original_english: Why does lactic acid form in muscles during exercise?
hinglish_roman: Exercise ke dauran muscles mein lactic acid kyun banta hai?

original_english: What is the definition of transpiration?
hinglish_roman: Transpiration ki definition kya hoti hai?

original_english: Can you give an example of a heterotrophic organism and how it gets nutrition?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap ek heterotrophic organism ka example de sakte hain aur yeh nutrition kaise leta hai?

original_english: How do alveoli help in the exchange of gases in the lungs?
hinglish_roman: Alveoli lungs mein gases ke exchange mein kaise help karte hain?

original_english: What is the difference between arteries and veins?
hinglish_roman: Arteries aur veins mein kya antar hota hai?

original_english: What are the raw materials needed for photosynthesis?
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis ke liye kaun se raw materials chahiye hote hain?

original_english: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants make their own food using sunlight.
hinglish_roman: Photosynthesis woh process hai jisme plants apna khud ka khana sunlight se banate hain.
hinglish_with_error: Photosynthesis woh process hai jisme plants apna khud ka khana sunlight se banatey hain.
gec_explanation: 'banatey' is a non-standard romanization; the correct Hinglish spelling is 'banate' following standard Hindi transliteration.

original_english: The kidneys filter waste products from the blood and produce urine.
hinglish_roman: Kidneys blood se waste products filter karke urine banate hain.
hinglish_with_error: Kidneys blood se waste products filter karke urine banatey hai.
gec_explanation: 'Kidneys' is plural, so the verb should be 'hain' (plural) not 'hai' (singular) to maintain subject-verb agreement.

original_english: Aerobic respiration takes place in the mitochondria and releases more energy than anaerobic respiration.
hinglish_roman: Aerobic respiration mitochondria mein hoti hai aur anaerobic respiration se zyada energy release karti hai.
hinglish_with_error: Aerobic respiration mitochondria mein hoti hai aur anaerobic respiration se jyada energy realese karti hai.
gec_explanation: 'realese' is a misspelling caused by transposing letters; the correct English spelling is 'release'.

original_english: Villi are present in the small intestine to increase the surface area for absorption of digested food.
hinglish_roman: Villi small intestine mein hote hain jo digested khaane ke absorption ke liye surface area badhate hain.
hinglish_with_error: Villi small intestine mein hota hai jo digested khaane ke absorption ke liye surface area badhate hain.
gec_explanation: 'Villi' is plural, so the verb must agree in number: 'hote hain' (plural) is correct, not 'hota hai' (singular).

original_english: Transpiration is the loss of water from the aerial parts of the plant in the form of vapour.
hinglish_roman: Transpiration plant ke upar wale hisson se vapour ke roop mein paani ka kho jaana hai.
hinglish_with_error: Transpiration plant ke upar wale hisson se vapour ke rup mein paani ka kho jaana hai.
gec_explanation: 'rup' is an informal or truncated spelling; the standard Hinglish transliteration of the Hindi word रूप is 'roop'.

original_english: Control and coordination are the functions of the nervous system and hormones in our bodies.
hinglish_roman: Control aur coordination hamare body mein nervous system aur hormones ka kaam hai.

original_english: All information from our environment is detected by the specialised tips of some nerve cells.
hinglish_roman: Hamare environment ki saari information kuch special nerve cells ke tips se detect hoti hai.

original_english: Receptors are usually located in our sense organs such as the inner ear, the nose, and the tongue.
hinglish_roman: Receptors aamtaur par hamare sense organs mein hote hain jaise inner ear, naak aur jeebh.

original_english: Gustatory receptors will detect taste while olfactory receptors will detect smell.
hinglish_roman: Gustatory receptors taste detect karte hain jabki olfactory receptors smell detect karte hain.

original_english: Information acquired at the dendritic tip sets off a chemical reaction that creates an electrical impulse.
hinglish_roman: Dendritic tip par mili information ek chemical reaction shuru karti hai jo electrical impulse create karta hai.

original_english: The electrical impulse travels from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon to its end.
hinglish_roman: Electrical impulse dendrite se cell body tak aur phir axon ke saath uske end tak travel karta hai.

original_english: At the end of the axon, the electrical impulse sets off the release of some chemicals.
hinglish_roman: Axon ke end par, electrical impulse kuch chemicals release karta hai.

original_english: These chemicals cross the gap or synapse and start a similar electrical impulse in the next neuron.
hinglish_roman: Yeh chemicals gap ya synapse cross karke agle neuron mein ek similar electrical impulse shuru karte hain.

original_english: Nervous tissue is made up of an organised network of nerve cells or neurons.
hinglish_roman: Nervous tissue nerve cells ya neurons ke ek organised network se bana hota hai.

original_english: A reflex is a sudden action in response to something in the environment without thinking about it.
hinglish_roman: Reflex ek aisi sudden action hai jo environment mein kisi cheez ke response mein bina soche hoti hai.

original_english: Touching a flame is an urgent and dangerous situation that requires a quick reflex response.
hinglish_roman: Aag ko chhoona ek urgent aur dangerous situation hai jisme quick reflex response chahiye.

original_english: A reflex arc is a connection between the input nerve and the output nerve made in the spinal cord.
hinglish_roman: Reflex arc spinal cord mein input nerve aur output nerve ke beech ek connection hota hai.

original_english: Nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord on their way to the brain.
hinglish_roman: Poore body se nerves ek bundle mein spinal cord mein milti hain jab woh brain ki taraf jaati hain.

original_english: Reflex arcs are formed in the spinal cord itself although the information also goes on to reach the brain.
hinglish_roman: Reflex arcs spinal cord mein hi form hote hain lekin information brain tak bhi pahunchti hai.

original_english: The brain and spinal cord together constitute the central nervous system.
hinglish_roman: Brain aur spinal cord milkar central nervous system banate hain.

original_english: The brain has three major parts: the fore-brain, mid-brain and hind-brain.
hinglish_roman: Brain ke teen major parts hain: fore-brain, mid-brain aur hind-brain.

original_english: The fore-brain is the main thinking part of the brain with regions that receive sensory impulses.
hinglish_roman: Fore-brain brain ka main thinking part hai jisme sensory impulses receive karne ke regions hote hain.

original_english: Separate areas of the fore-brain are specialised for hearing, smell, sight and so on.
hinglish_roman: Fore-brain ke alag-alag areas hearing, smell, sight aur baaki cheezein ke liye specialised hote hain.

original_english: Many involuntary actions are controlled by the mid-brain and hind-brain.
hinglish_roman: Bahut saari involuntary actions mid-brain aur hind-brain ke dwara control hoti hain.

original_english: Involuntary actions including blood pressure, salivation and vomiting are controlled by the medulla in the hind-brain.
hinglish_roman: Blood pressure, salivation aur vomiting jaise involuntary actions hind-brain ke medulla se control hote hain.

original_english: The cerebellum is responsible for precision of voluntary actions and maintaining the posture and balance of the body.
hinglish_roman: Cerebellum voluntary actions ki precision aur body ka posture aur balance maintain karne ke liye responsible hai.

original_english: The brain sits inside a bony box and is surrounded by a fluid-filled balloon for shock absorption.
hinglish_roman: Brain ek bony box ke andar hota hai aur shock absorption ke liye fluid-filled balloon se ghira hota hai.

original_english: The vertebral column or backbone protects the spinal cord.
hinglish_roman: Vertebral column ya backbone spinal cord ki raksha karta hai.

original_english: Muscle cells have special proteins that change their shape and arrangement in response to nervous electrical impulses.
hinglish_roman: Muscle cells mein special proteins hote hain jo nervous electrical impulses ke response mein apni shape aur arrangement change karte hain.

original_english: Plants also use electrical-chemical means to convey information from cell to cell.
hinglish_roman: Plants bhi ek cell se doosre cell tak information pahunchane ke liye electrical-chemical tarike use karte hain.

original_english: Plants show two different types of movement: one dependent on growth and the other independent of growth.
hinglish_roman: Plants do alag tarah ki movement dikhate hain: ek growth par dependent aur doosri growth se independent.

original_english: The leaves of the sensitive plant move very quickly in response to touch without any growth.
hinglish_roman: Sensitive plant ki pattiyan bina kisi growth ke touch ke response mein bahut jaldi hilti hain.

original_english: Plant cells change shape by changing the amount of water in them, resulting in swelling or shrinking.
hinglish_roman: Plant cells mein paani ki maatra badalne se unka shape change hota hai, jiske wajah se woh phoolte ya sikudte hain.

original_english: Environmental triggers such as light or gravity change the directions that plant parts grow in.
hinglish_roman: Light ya gravity jaise environmental triggers plant ke parts ki growth ki direction change karte hain.

original_english: In phototropic movement, shoots respond by bending towards light while roots respond by bending away from it.
hinglish_roman: Phototropic movement mein shoots light ki taraf jhuk jaate hain jabki roots usse door jhuk jaati hain.

original_english: Geotropism is the upward and downward growth of shoots and roots respectively in response to gravity.
hinglish_roman: Geotropism gravity ke response mein shoots ka upar aur roots ka neeche growth hai.

original_english: Chemotropism is the growth of pollen tubes towards ovules.
hinglish_roman: Chemotropism pollen tubes ka ovules ki taraf growth hai.

original_english: Electrical impulses are an excellent means for fast information transfer but can only reach cells connected by nervous tissue.
hinglish_roman: Electrical impulses fast information transfer ke liye bahut achha tarika hai lekin yeh sirf nervous tissue se connected cells tak pahunch sakta hai.

original_english: Hormones are chemicals used by multicellular organisms for control and coordination.
hinglish_roman: Hormones woh chemicals hain jo multicellular organisms control aur coordination ke liye use karte hain.

original_english: Different plant hormones help to coordinate growth, development and responses to the environment.
hinglish_roman: Alag-alag plant hormones growth, development aur environment ke response ko coordinate karne mein madad karte hain.

original_english: Auxin is a hormone synthesised at the shoot tip that helps the cells to grow longer.
hinglish_roman: Auxin ek hormone hai jo shoot tip par banta hai aur cells ko lamba hone mein madad karta hai.

original_english: When light comes from one side, auxin diffuses towards the shady side of the shoot causing it to bend towards light.
hinglish_roman: Jab ek taraf se light aati hai, auxin shoot ke chhaon wale side ki taraf diffuse hota hai aur shoot light ki taraf jhuk jaata hai.

original_english: Gibberellins help in the growth of the stem similar to auxins.
hinglish_roman: Gibberellins auxins ki tarah stem ki growth mein madad karte hain.

original_english: Cytokinins promote cell division and are present in greater concentration in fruits and seeds.
hinglish_roman: Cytokinins cell division badhate hain aur fruits aur seeds mein zyada concentration mein hote hain.

original_english: Abscisic acid is a plant hormone that inhibits growth and causes wilting of leaves.
hinglish_roman: Abscisic acid ek plant hormone hai jo growth rok deta hai aur pattiyon ko murjha deta hai.

original_english: Adrenaline is a hormone secreted from the adrenal glands directly into the blood.
hinglish_roman: Adrenaline ek hormone hai jo adrenal glands se seedha khoon mein secrete hota hai.

original_english: Adrenaline causes the heart to beat faster resulting in supply of more oxygen to muscles.
hinglish_roman: Adrenaline ki wajah se dil tez dhadakta hai jisse muscles ko zyada oxygen milti hai.

original_english: Blood to the digestive system and skin is reduced due to contraction of muscles around small arteries.
hinglish_roman: Chhoti arteries ke aas-paas muscles ke sikudne se digestive system aur skin mein khoon ka flow kam ho jaata hai.

original_english: The breathing rate also increases because of the contractions of the diaphragm and the rib muscles.
hinglish_roman: Diaphragm aur rib muscles ke sikudne ki wajah se saans lene ki dhar bhi tej ho jaati hai.

original_english: The endocrine system constitutes a second way of control and coordination in our body.
hinglish_roman: Endocrine system hamare body mein control aur coordination ka doosra tarika hai.

original_english: Iodine is necessary for the thyroid gland to make thyroxin hormone.
hinglish_roman: Thyroid gland ko thyroxin hormone banane ke liye iodine zaroori hai.

original_english: Thyroxin regulates carbohydrate, protein and fat metabolism in the body to provide the best balance for growth.
hinglish_roman: Thyroxin body mein carbohydrate, protein aur fat metabolism ko regulate karke growth ke liye best balance deta hai.

original_english: If iodine is deficient in our diet, we might suffer from goitre, a disease causing a swollen neck.
hinglish_roman: Agar hamare khane mein iodine ki kami ho, toh hum goitre se pareshan ho sakte hain jisme gala sooj jaata hai.

original_english: Growth hormone is secreted by the pituitary gland and regulates growth and development of the body.
hinglish_roman: Growth hormone pituitary gland se secrete hota hai aur body ke growth aur development ko regulate karta hai.

original_english: If there is a deficiency of growth hormone in childhood it leads to dwarfism.
hinglish_roman: Agar bachpan mein growth hormone ki kami ho, toh dwarfism ho sakta hai.

original_english: Changes associated with puberty are because of the secretion of testosterone in males and oestrogen in females.
hinglish_roman: Puberty ke saath hone wale changes ladkon mein testosterone aur ladkiyon mein oestrogen ke secretion ki wajah se hote hain.

original_english: Insulin is a hormone produced by the pancreas that helps in regulating blood sugar levels.
hinglish_roman: Insulin pancreas se banna ek hormone hai jo blood sugar levels ko regulate karne mein madad karta hai.

original_english: If insulin is not secreted in proper amounts, the sugar level in the blood rises causing harmful effects.
hinglish_roman: Agar insulin sahi maatra mein secrete na ho, toh blood mein sugar level badh jaata hai jo haanikaarak hai.

original_english: The timing and amount of hormone released are regulated by feedback mechanisms.
hinglish_roman: Hormone kitni maatra mein aur kab release hoga yeh feedback mechanisms se regulate hota hai.

original_english: If blood sugar levels rise, the pancreas produces more insulin, and as sugar levels fall, insulin secretion is reduced.
hinglish_roman: Jab blood sugar level badhe, pancreas zyada insulin banata hai, aur jab sugar level ghate, insulin secretion kam hoti hai.

original_english: Movement in response to the environment is carefully controlled in living organisms.
hinglish_roman: Jeevit praaniyon mein environment ke response mein movement bahut carefully control hoti hai.

original_english: Specialised tissues are used to provide control and coordination activities in multicellular organisms.
hinglish_roman: Multicellular organisms mein control aur coordination ke liye specialised tissues use hote hain.

original_english: In animals, control and coordination are provided by nervous and muscular tissues.
hinglish_roman: Jaanwaron mein control aur coordination nervous aur muscular tissues se milta hai.

original_english: The communication between the central nervous system and the other parts of the body is facilitated by the peripheral nervous system.
hinglish_roman: Central nervous system aur body ke baaki hisson ke beech communication peripheral nervous system ke zariye hota hai.

original_english: Writing, talking, and moving a chair are examples of voluntary actions based on deciding what to do next.
hinglish_roman: Likhna, bolna aur kursi hilana voluntary actions ke examples hain jo aage kya karna hai, iske faisle par based hain.

original_english: Walking in a straight line, riding a bicycle and picking up a pencil are possible due to the cerebellum.
hinglish_roman: Seedhi line mein chalna, cycle chalana aur pencil uthana cerebellum ki wajah se possible hai.

original_english: Our hearts beat without our thinking about it as an involuntary action.
hinglish_roman: Hamaara dil bina soche ek involuntary action ki tarah dhadakta rehta hai.

original_english: Pea plant tendrils are sensitive to touch and coil around any support they come in contact with.
hinglish_roman: Matar ke plant ki tendrils touch ke liye sensitive hoti hain aur jis bhi support se milti hain uske aas-paas lapet jaati hain.

original_english: The part of the tendril in contact with the object does not grow as rapidly as the part away from the object.
hinglish_roman: Tendril ka jo part object se contact mein hai woh utni tezi se nahi badhta jitna door wala part badhta hai.

original_english: Hormones produced in one part of an organism move to another part to achieve the desired effect.
hinglish_roman: Ek organism ke ek hisse mein bane hormones doosre hisse mein jaake desired effect hasil karte hain.

original_english: A chemical signal released by stimulated cells can diffuse all around and be detected by nearby cells.
hinglish_roman: Stimulated cells se release hua chemical signal aas-paas diffuse hota hai aur nearby cells usse detect kar leti hain.

original_english: The nervous system gets information from our sense organs and acts through our muscles.
hinglish_roman: Nervous system hamare sense organs se information leta hai aur hamare muscles ke zariye kaam karta hai.

original_english: The responses of the nervous system can be classified as reflex action, voluntary action or involuntary action.
hinglish_roman: Nervous system ke responses ko reflex action, voluntary action ya involuntary action mein classify kiya jaata hai.

original_english: Hypothalamus plays an important role in the release of many hormones.
hinglish_roman: Hypothalamus bahut se hormones ke release mein important role play karta hai.

original_english: When the level of growth hormone is low, the hypothalamus releases growth hormone releasing factor.
hinglish_roman: Jab growth hormone ka level kam ho, hypothalamus growth hormone releasing factor release karta hai.

original_english: Plant cells change shape by changing the amount of water in them resulting in swelling or shrinking.
hinglish_roman: Plant cells apne andar paani ki maatra badal kar apni shape change karte hain, jisse woh phoolte ya simatat hain.

original_english: The roots of a plant always grow downwards while the shoots grow upwards in response to gravity.
hinglish_roman: Gravity ke response mein plant ki roots hamesha neeche badhti hain jabki shoots upar badhte hain.

original_english: The thinking tissue in our body consists of dense networks of intricately arranged neurons in the brain.
hinglish_roman: Hamare body mein thinking tissue brain mein bahut ghane aur pechida tarike se arrange neurons ke network se bana hota hai.

original_english: Plants respond to stimuli slowly by growing in a particular direction which appears as movement.
hinglish_roman: Plants dheere-dheere ek specific direction mein growth karke stimuli ka response dete hain jo movement jaisa lagta hai.

original_english: Chemical coordination in plants and animals involves hormones that are synthesised at one place and act at another.
hinglish_roman: Plants aur animals mein chemical coordination mein aise hormones hote hain jo ek jagah banate hain aur doosri jagah kaam karte hain.

original_english: What is the difference between a reflex action and walking?
hinglish_roman: Reflex action aur walking mein kya antar hai?

original_english: What happens at the synapse between two neurons?
hinglish_roman: Do neurons ke beech synapse par kya hota hai?

original_english: Which part of the brain maintains posture and equilibrium of the body?
hinglish_roman: Brain ka kaun sa part body ka posture aur equilibrium maintain karta hai?

original_english: How do we detect the smell of an agarbatti?
hinglish_roman: Hum agarbatti ki smell kaise detect karte hain?

original_english: What is the role of the brain in reflex action?
hinglish_roman: Reflex action mein brain ka kya role hota hai?

original_english: What are plant hormones?
hinglish_roman: Plant hormones kya hote hain?

original_english: How is the movement of leaves of the sensitive plant different from the movement of a shoot towards light?
hinglish_roman: Sensitive plant ki pattiyon ki movement aur shoot ki light ki taraf movement mein kya fark hai?

original_english: Give an example of a plant hormone that promotes growth.
hinglish_roman: Ek aisi plant hormone ka example do jo growth promote kare.

original_english: Why is the use of iodised salt advisable?
hinglish_roman: Iodised salt use karna kyun zaroori hai?

original_english: How does our body respond when adrenaline is secreted into the blood?
hinglish_roman: Jab adrenaline khoon mein secrete hota hai toh hamara body kaise respond karta hai?

original_english: Why are some patients of diabetes treated by giving injections of insulin?
hinglish_roman: Kuch diabetes patients ko insulin ke injections kyun diye jaate hain?

original_english: What is the function of receptors in our body?
hinglish_roman: Hamare body mein receptors ka kya kaam hota hai?

original_english: How does phototropism occur in plants?
hinglish_roman: Plants mein phototropism kaise hota hai?

original_english: Compare and contrast nervous and hormonal mechanisms for control and coordination in animals.
hinglish_roman: Animals mein nervous aur hormonal mechanisms ko control aur coordination ke liye compare karo.

original_english: How do auxins promote the growth of a tendril around a support?
hinglish_roman: Auxins kaise tendril ko support ke aas-paas badhne mein help karte hain?

original_english: Reflex actions are controlled by the spinal cord not the brain.
hinglish_roman: Reflex actions brain se nahi, spinal cord se control hoti hain.
hinglish_with_error: Reflex actions brain se nahi, spinal cord se controls hoti hain.
gec_explanation: In Hindi-English code-mixed sentences, English verbs paired with Hindi auxiliaries like 'hoti hain' should remain in base form. 'controls' is incorrect; the base form 'control' is needed since the auxiliary 'hoti hain' carries the tense and agreement.

original_english: Adrenaline is released when we are in a scary or dangerous situation.
hinglish_roman: Jab hum ek scary ya dangerous situation mein hote hain tab adrenaline release hota hai.
hinglish_with_error: Jab hum ek scary ya dangerous situation mein hoti hain tab adrenaline release hota hai.
gec_explanation: 'Hum' (we) in Hindi is treated as masculine or neutral plural; the correct auxiliary is 'hote hain' not 'hoti hain'. 'Hoti' is the feminine form and is grammatically incorrect when the subject 'hum' is generic or masculine.

original_english: Neurons transmit electrical impulses from one part of the body to another.
hinglish_roman: Neurons electrical impulses ek body part se doosre mein transmit karte hain.
hinglish_with_error: Neurons electrical impulses ek body part se doosre mein transmits karte hain.
gec_explanation: When an English verb is used with Hindi compound verb structure ('karte hain'), the English verb should be in its base/infinitive form. 'Transmits' includes the third-person singular inflection which is redundant and incorrect when followed by 'karte hain' which itself carries subject agreement.

original_english: The pituitary gland secretes growth hormone which regulates body development.
hinglish_roman: Pituitary gland growth hormone secrete karta hai jo body development regulate karta hai.
hinglish_with_error: Pituitary gland growth hormone secrete karti hai jo body development regulate karta hai.
gec_explanation: In Hindi, 'gland' is treated as a masculine noun (or defaults to masculine in code-mixed usage), so the auxiliary should be 'karta hai' (masculine) not 'karti hai' (feminine). Using 'karti' creates a gender agreement error with the subject 'pituitary gland'.

original_english: Auxin hormone helps the shoot to bend towards light by promoting cell elongation.
hinglish_roman: Auxin hormone shoot ko light ki taraf jhukne mein madad karta hai cell elongation promote karke.
hinglish_with_error: Auxin hormone shoot ko light ki taraf jhukne mein madad karta hai cell elongation promotes karke.
gec_explanation: When an English verb precedes the Hindi participial form 'karke' (having done / by doing), it must be in its base form. 'Promotes karke' is incorrect; 'promote karke' is the grammatically correct code-mixed form. Adding the '-s' inflection conflicts with the role of 'karke' which already encodes the verbal meaning.

original_english: Reproduction is not necessary to maintain the life of an individual organism, unlike the essential life processes such as nutrition, respiration, or excretion.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction kisi individual organism ki life maintain karne ke liye zaroori nahi hai, unlike essential life processes jaise nutrition, respiration, ya excretion.

original_english: If an individual organism is going to create more individuals, a lot of its energy will be spent in the process.
hinglish_roman: Agar ek individual organism aur individuals create karne wala hai, toh uski bahut saari energy is process mein spend hogi.

original_english: Reproducing organisms create new individuals that look very much like themselves.
hinglish_roman: Reproducing organisms aise naye individuals create karte hain jo dekhne mein bilkul unke jaisa hote hain.

original_english: Organisms look similar because their body designs are similar.
hinglish_roman: Organisms similar dikhte hain kyunki unke body designs similar hote hain.

original_english: Reproduction at its most basic level will involve making copies of the blueprints of body design.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction apne sabse basic level par body design ke blueprints ki copies banana involve karta hai.

original_english: The chromosomes in the nucleus of a cell contain information for inheritance of features from parents to next generation in the form of DNA molecules.
hinglish_roman: Cell ke nucleus mein chromosomes parents se next generation tak features ki inheritance ke liye DNA molecules ke form mein information contain karte hain.

original_english: The DNA in the cell nucleus is the information source for making proteins.
hinglish_roman: Cell nucleus mein DNA proteins banane ke liye information source hai.

original_english: If the information is changed, different proteins will be made, leading to altered body designs.
hinglish_roman: Agar information change ho jaye, toh different proteins banenge, jisse body designs alter ho jayenge.

original_english: A basic event in reproduction is the creation of a DNA copy. Cells use chemical reactions to build copies of their DNA.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction mein ek basic event DNA copy ka creation hai. Cells apni DNA ki copies banane ke liye chemical reactions use karte hain.

original_english: DNA copying is accompanied by the creation of an additional cellular apparatus, and then the DNA copies separate, each with its own cellular apparatus.
hinglish_roman: DNA copying ke saath ek additional cellular apparatus ka creation hota hai, aur phir DNA copies alag ho jaati hain, har ek apne cellular apparatus ke saath.

original_english: No biochemical reaction is absolutely reliable, therefore the process of copying the DNA will have some variations each time.
hinglish_roman: Koi bhi biochemical reaction absolutely reliable nahi hota, isliye DNA copying ke process mein har baar kuch variations aayenge.

original_english: The surviving cells are similar to, but subtly different from each other. This inbuilt tendency for variation during reproduction is the basis for evolution.
hinglish_roman: Surviving cells ek dusre se similar hoti hain, lekin subtly different. Reproduction ke dauran variation ki yeh inbuilt tendency evolution ka basis hai.

original_english: Populations of organisms fill well-defined places, or niches, in the ecosystem, using their ability to reproduce.
hinglish_roman: Organisms ki populations ecosystem mein well-defined places ya niches fill karti hain, apni reproduce karne ki ability use karke.

original_english: Reproduction is linked to the stability of populations of species.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction species ki populations ki stability se linked hai.

original_english: If a population of reproducing organisms were suited to a particular niche and the niche were drastically altered, the population could be wiped out.
hinglish_roman: Agar reproducing organisms ki population ek particular niche ke liye suited ho aur niche drastically alter ho jaye, toh population khatam ho sakti hai.

original_english: If some variations were present in a few individuals, there would be some chance for them to survive when the niche changes.
hinglish_roman: Agar kuch individuals mein variations present hon, toh niche change hone par unke survive karne ke chances hote hain.

original_english: Variation is useful for the survival of species over time.
hinglish_roman: Variation time ke saath species ke survival ke liye useful hai.

original_english: For unicellular organisms, cell division, or fission, leads to the creation of new individuals.
hinglish_roman: Unicellular organisms ke liye cell division ya fission se naye individuals ka creation hota hai.

original_english: Many bacteria and protozoa simply split into two equal halves during cell division.
hinglish_roman: Bahut se bacteria aur protozoa cell division ke dauran simply do barabar halves mein split ho jaate hain.

original_english: In Amoeba, the splitting of the two cells during division can take place in any plane. This is called binary fission.
hinglish_roman: Amoeba mein division ke dauran do cells ka splitting kisi bhi plane mein ho sakta hai. Ise binary fission kehte hain.

original_english: Leishmania, which causes kala-azar, has a whip-like structure at one end. Binary fission occurs in a definite orientation in relation to these structures.
hinglish_roman: Leishmania, jo kala-azar ka kaaran hai, uske ek end par whip-like structure hoti hai. Binary fission in structures ke relation mein ek definite orientation mein hota hai.

original_english: Plasmodium, the malarial parasite, divides into many daughter cells simultaneously by multiple fission.
hinglish_roman: Plasmodium, jo malarial parasite hai, multiple fission ke zariye simultaneously kai daughter cells mein divide hota hai.

original_english: Spirogyra simply breaks up into smaller pieces upon maturation. These pieces or fragments grow into new individuals.
hinglish_roman: Spirogyra maturation hone par simply chhote pieces mein toot jaata hai. Yeh pieces ya fragments naye individuals mein grow karte hain.

original_english: Many multi-cellular organisms are not simply a random collection of cells. Specialised cells are organised as tissues, and tissues are organised into organs.
hinglish_roman: Kai multi-cellular organisms simply cells ka random collection nahi hain. Specialised cells tissues ke roop mein organised hoti hain, aur tissues organs mein organised hoti hain.

original_english: Simple animals like Hydra and Planaria can be cut into any number of pieces and each piece grows into a complete organism. This is known as regeneration.
hinglish_roman: Hydra aur Planaria jaise simple animals ko kitne bhi pieces mein kaat sakte hain aur har piece ek complete organism mein grow karta hai. Ise regeneration kehte hain.

original_english: Regeneration is carried out by specialised cells which proliferate and make large numbers of cells that undergo changes to become various cell types.
hinglish_roman: Regeneration specialised cells ke dwara hota hai jo proliferate karke bahut saari cells banaati hain, phir yeh cells changes se guzar kar various cell types ban jaati hain.

original_english: Regeneration is not the same as reproduction, since most organisms would not normally depend on being cut up to reproduce.
hinglish_roman: Regeneration aur reproduction same nahi hai, kyunki zyaadatar organisms normally reproduce karne ke liye kate jaane par depend nahi karte.

original_english: In Hydra, a bud develops as an outgrowth due to repeated cell division at one specific site. These buds develop into tiny individuals.
hinglish_roman: Hydra mein ek bud repeated cell division ki wajah se ek specific site par outgrowth ke roop mein develop hoti hai. Yeh buds tiny individuals mein develop hoti hain.

original_english: When fully mature, the buds detach from the parent body and become new independent individuals.
hinglish_roman: Jab fully mature ho jaate hain, toh buds parent body se detach hokar naye independent individuals ban jaate hain.

original_english: In many plants, parts like the root, stem and leaves develop into new plants under appropriate conditions. This is called vegetative propagation.
hinglish_roman: Kai plants mein root, stem aur leaves jaise parts appropriate conditions mein naye plants mein develop ho jaate hain. Ise vegetative propagation kehte hain.

original_english: Vegetative propagation is used in methods such as layering or grafting to grow plants like sugarcane, roses, or grapes.
hinglish_roman: Vegetative propagation ko layering ya grafting jaise methods mein use kiya jaata hai sugarcane, roses ya grapes jaise plants ugaane ke liye.

original_english: Plants raised by vegetative propagation can bear flowers and fruits earlier than those produced from seeds.
hinglish_roman: Vegetative propagation se ugaaye gaye plants seeds se produce hone wale plants ki tulna mein pehle flowers aur fruits de sakte hain.

original_english: Buds produced in the notches along the leaf margin of Bryophyllum fall on the soil and develop into new plants.
hinglish_roman: Bryophyllum ki leaf margin ke notches mein buds bante hain jo soil par girte hain aur naye plants mein develop ho jaate hain.

original_english: In tissue culture, new plants are grown by removing tissue or separating cells from the growing tip of a plant.
hinglish_roman: Tissue culture mein plant ke growing tip se tissue remove karke ya cells separate karke naye plants ugaaye jaate hain.

original_english: The sporangia contain cells, or spores, that can eventually develop into new Rhizopus individuals. The spores are covered by thick walls that protect them.
hinglish_roman: Sporangia mein cells ya spores hote hain jo eventually naye Rhizopus individuals mein develop ho sakte hain. Spores thick walls se covered hote hain jo unhe protect karti hain.

original_english: All the modes of reproduction that allow new generations to be created from a single individual is known as asexual reproduction.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction ke woh saare modes jinme ek single individual se naye generations create hote hain, unhe asexual reproduction kehte hain.

original_english: Yeast can put out small buds that separate and grow further.
hinglish_roman: Yeast chhoti buds nikaalti hai jo alag hokar aur grow karti hain.

original_english: Sexual reproduction involves two individuals for the creation of a new individual.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction mein ek naya individual create karne ke liye do individuals ki zaroorat hoti hai.

original_english: The DNA copying mechanism cannot be absolutely accurate, and the resultant errors are a source of variations in populations.
hinglish_roman: DNA copying mechanism absolutely accurate nahi ho sakta, aur resultant errors populations mein variations ka source hain.

original_english: Combining variations from two or more individuals creates new combinations of variants. The sexual mode of reproduction incorporates this process.
hinglish_roman: Do ya zyaada individuals se variations combine karne se variants ke naye combinations bante hain. Sexual mode of reproduction is process ko incorporate karta hai.

original_english: Special lineages of cells in specialised organs have only half the number of chromosomes, achieved by meiosis.
hinglish_roman: Specialised organs mein cells ke special lineages mein sirf aadhi chromosomes ki sankhya hoti hai, jo meiosis ke zariye achieve hoti hai.

original_english: When germ-cells from two individuals combine during sexual reproduction, it results in re-establishment of the number of chromosomes in the new generation.
hinglish_roman: Jab do individuals ke germ-cells sexual reproduction ke dauran combine hote hain, toh new generation mein chromosomes ki sankhya phir se re-establish ho jaati hai.

original_english: The motile germ-cell is called the male gamete and the germ-cell containing the stored food is called the female gamete.
hinglish_roman: Motile germ-cell ko male gamete kehte hain aur stored food wali germ-cell ko female gamete kehte hain.

original_english: The reproductive parts of angiosperms are located in the flower. Stamens and pistil are the reproductive parts which contain the germ-cells.
hinglish_roman: Angiosperms ke reproductive parts flower mein located hote hain. Stamens aur pistil reproductive parts hain jinme germ-cells hote hain.

original_english: The flower may be unisexual like papaya and watermelon, or bisexual like Hibiscus and mustard.
hinglish_roman: Flower unisexual ho sakta hai jaise papaya aur watermelon, ya bisexual jaise Hibiscus aur mustard.

original_english: Stamen is the male reproductive part and it produces pollen grains that are yellowish in colour.
hinglish_roman: Stamen male reproductive part hai aur yeh yellowish colour ke pollen grains produce karta hai.

original_english: Pistil is the female reproductive part made of three parts: the swollen bottom ovary, the middle elongated style, and the terminal sticky stigma.
hinglish_roman: Pistil female reproductive part hai jo teen parts se bana hai: neeche ka soojan wala ovary, beech ka lamba style, aur upar ka chipchipa stigma.

original_english: The male germ-cell produced by pollen grain fuses with the female gamete present in the ovule. This fusion is called fertilisation.
hinglish_roman: Pollen grain se produce hone wala male germ-cell ovule mein present female gamete se fuse hota hai. Is fusion ko fertilisation kehte hain.

original_english: If the transfer of pollen occurs in the same flower, it is self-pollination. If transferred from one flower to another, it is cross-pollination.
hinglish_roman: Agar pollen ka transfer same flower mein ho toh use self-pollination kehte hain. Agar ek flower se dusre flower mein ho toh use cross-pollination kehte hain.

original_english: After pollination, a tube grows out of the pollen grain and travels through the style to reach the ovary.
hinglish_roman: Pollination ke baad pollen grain se ek tube nikalti hai jo style ke through travel karke ovary tak pahunchti hai.

original_english: After fertilisation, the zygote divides several times to form an embryo within the ovule. The ovule develops a tough coat and becomes a seed.
hinglish_roman: Fertilisation ke baad zygote kai baar divide hokar ovule ke andar embryo banata hai. Ovule ek tough coat develop karke seed ban jaata hai.

original_english: The ovary grows rapidly and ripens to form a fruit. The seed contains the embryo which develops into a seedling under appropriate conditions, called germination.
hinglish_roman: Ovary rapidly grow hokar ripen hota hai aur fruit banta hai. Seed mein embryo hota hai jo appropriate conditions mein seedling mein develop hota hai, ise germination kehte hain.

original_english: In early teenage years, a new set of changes occurs that cannot be explained simply as body enlargement. The appearance of the body changes.
hinglish_roman: Early teenage years mein changes ka ek naya set hota hai jo simply body enlargement se explain nahi ho sakta. Body ki appearance change hoti hai.

original_english: Thick hair grows in new parts of the body such as armpits and the genital area. The skin frequently becomes oily and pimples may develop.
hinglish_roman: Body ke naye parts mein thick hair ugne lagte hain jaise armpits aur genital area. Skin aksar oily ho jaati hai aur pimples aa sakte hain.

original_english: In girls, breast size begins to increase and menstruation starts. Boys begin to have thick hair growth on the face and their voices begin to crack.
hinglish_roman: Girls mein breast size badhne lagta hai aur menstruation shuru hota hai. Boys ke face par thick hair growth hone lagti hai aur unki awaaz badalti hai.

original_english: As the rate of general body growth begins to slow down, reproductive tissues begin to mature. This period during adolescence is called puberty.
hinglish_roman: Jab general body growth ki rate slow hone lagti hai, toh reproductive tissues mature hone lagte hain. Adolescence ka yeh period puberty kehlata hai.

original_english: The formation of sperms takes place in the testes, located outside the abdominal cavity in the scrotum because sperm formation requires a lower temperature.
hinglish_roman: Sperms ka formation testes mein hota hai, jo abdominal cavity ke baahar scrotum mein located hain kyunki sperm formation ke liye lower temperature chahiye.

original_english: Testosterone regulates the formation of sperms and brings about changes in appearance seen in boys at puberty.
hinglish_roman: Testosterone sperms ke formation ko regulate karta hai aur puberty ke time boys mein appearance ke changes laata hai.

original_english: The sperms formed are delivered through the vas deferens. The urethra forms a common passage for both the sperms and urine.
hinglish_roman: Sperms vas deferens ke through deliver hote hain. Urethra sperms aur urine dono ke liye common passage hai.

original_english: Glands like the prostate and the seminal vesicles add their secretions so that the sperms are in a fluid which makes transport easier and provides nutrition.
hinglish_roman: Prostate aur seminal vesicles jaise glands apne secretions add karte hain taaki sperms ek fluid mein hon jo transport easier banata hai aur nutrition provide karta hai.

original_english: The female germ-cells or eggs are made in the ovaries. One egg is produced every month by one of the ovaries.
hinglish_roman: Female germ-cells ya eggs ovaries mein banti hain. Har mahine ek ovary se ek egg produce hota hai.

original_english: The egg is carried from the ovary to the womb through a thin oviduct or fallopian tube. The two oviducts unite into an elastic bag-like structure known as the uterus.
hinglish_roman: Egg ovary se womb tak thin oviduct ya fallopian tube ke through jaata hai. Dono oviducts milkar ek elastic bag jaisi structure banate hain jise uterus kehte hain.

original_english: The fertilised egg starts dividing to form an embryo, which is implanted in the lining of the uterus where it grows and develops organs to become a foetus.
hinglish_roman: Fertilised egg divide hokar embryo banata hai, jo uterus ki lining mein implant hota hai jahan yeh grow karke organs develop karta hai aur foetus banta hai.

original_english: The embryo gets nutrition from the mother's blood with the help of a special tissue called placenta.
hinglish_roman: Embryo ko mother ke blood se nutrition milta hai ek special tissue ki madad se jise placenta kehte hain.

original_english: Placenta is a disc embedded in the uterine wall with villi on the embryo's side and blood spaces on the mother's side, providing a large surface area for glucose and oxygen exchange.
hinglish_roman: Placenta ek disc hai jo uterine wall mein embedded hoti hai, embryo ki side par villi hote hain aur mother ki side par blood spaces, jo glucose aur oxygen exchange ke liye large surface area provide karte hain.

original_english: The development of the child inside the mother's body takes approximately nine months. The child is born as a result of rhythmic contractions of muscles in the uterus.
hinglish_roman: Mother ke body ke andar bachche ka development lagbhag nau mahine leta hai. Uterus ki muscles ke rhythmic contractions se bachcha paida hota hai.

original_english: If the egg is not fertilised, it lives for about one day. The uterus lining slowly breaks and comes out through the vagina as blood and mucous. This is menstruation.
hinglish_roman: Agar egg fertilise na ho toh yeh lagbhag ek din tak jeeta hai. Uterus ki lining dheere dheere tootkar vagina se blood aur mucous ke roop mein baahar aati hai. Ise menstruation kehte hain.

original_english: Sexually transmitted diseases include bacterial infections such as gonorrhoea and syphilis, and viral infections such as warts and HIV-AIDS.
hinglish_roman: Sexually transmitted diseases mein bacterial infections jaise gonorrhoea aur syphilis, aur viral infections jaise warts aur HIV-AIDS shamil hain.

original_english: Using a condom for the penis during sex helps to prevent transmission of many sexually transmitted infections.
hinglish_roman: Sex ke dauran penis par condom use karna kai sexually transmitted infections ke transmission ko rokne mein madad karta hai.

original_english: Contraceptive methods include mechanical barriers like condoms, hormonal pills that prevent egg release, and devices like copper-T placed in the uterus.
hinglish_roman: Contraceptive methods mein condoms jaise mechanical barriers, hormonal pills jo egg release rokti hain, aur copper-T jaise devices jo uterus mein place kiye jaate hain shamil hain.

original_english: Surgical methods can block the vas deferens in males or the fallopian tube in females to prevent fertilisation.
hinglish_roman: Surgical methods se males mein vas deferens ya females mein fallopian tube ko block kiya ja sakta hai taaki fertilisation na ho.

original_english: Prenatal sex determination has been prohibited by law because of reckless female foeticides causing a declining child sex ratio.
hinglish_roman: Prenatal sex determination ko law ke dwara prohibit kiya gaya hai kyunki reckless female foeticides ki wajah se child sex ratio decline ho raha hai.

original_english: All plants produced by vegetative propagation are genetically similar enough to the parent plant to have all its characteristics.
hinglish_roman: Vegetative propagation se produce hue saare plants genetically parent plant se itne similar hote hain ki unme uski saari characteristics hoti hain.

original_english: The sperms are tiny bodies that consist mainly of genetic material and a long tail that helps them move towards the female germ-cell.
hinglish_roman: Sperms tiny bodies hain jo mainly genetic material se bane hote hain aur ek long tail hoti hai jo unhe female germ-cell ki taraf move karne mein help karti hai.

original_english: Hormonal pills change the hormonal balance of the body so that eggs are not released and fertilisation cannot occur, but they can cause side-effects.
hinglish_roman: Hormonal pills body ke hormonal balance ko change karti hain taaki eggs release na hon aur fertilisation na ho sake, lekin iske side-effects ho sakte hain.

original_english: What is the importance of DNA copying in reproduction?
hinglish_roman: Reproduction mein DNA copying ki kya importance hai?

original_english: Why is variation beneficial to the species but not necessarily for the individual?
hinglish_roman: Variation species ke liye beneficial kyun hai lekin individual ke liye necessarily nahi?

original_english: How does binary fission differ from multiple fission?
hinglish_roman: Binary fission multiple fission se kaise alag hai?

original_english: Can you give an example of an organism that reproduces by budding?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap ek organism ka example de sakte hain jo budding se reproduce karta hai?

original_english: Why is vegetative propagation practised for growing some types of plants?
hinglish_roman: Kuch types ke plants ugaane ke liye vegetative propagation kyun practise kiya jaata hai?

original_english: What is the definition of regeneration in biology?
hinglish_roman: Biology mein regeneration ki definition kya hai?

original_english: How is the process of pollination different from fertilisation?
hinglish_roman: Pollination ka process fertilisation se kaise different hai?

original_english: What is the role of the seminal vesicles and the prostate gland?
hinglish_roman: Seminal vesicles aur prostate gland ka role kya hai?

original_english: How does the embryo get nourishment inside the mother's body?
hinglish_roman: Mother ke body ke andar embryo ko nourishment kaise milta hai?

original_english: Can you give an example showing how variation helps a species survive environmental changes?
hinglish_roman: Kya aap ek example de sakte hain jo dikhaye ki variation kaise species ko environmental changes mein survive karne mein help karta hai?

original_english: Why can more complex organisms not give rise to new individuals through regeneration?
hinglish_roman: Complex organisms regeneration ke through naye individuals ko kyun paida nahi kar sakte?

original_english: What are the advantages of sexual reproduction over asexual reproduction?
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction ke comparison mein sexual reproduction ke kya advantages hain?

original_english: What is the definition of puberty?
hinglish_roman: Puberty ki definition kya hai?

original_english: Why does menstruation occur?
hinglish_roman: Menstruation kyun hota hai?

original_english: What are the different methods of contraception?
hinglish_roman: Contraception ke different methods kya kya hain?

original_english: Reproduction mein DNA copying ki importance bahut zyaada hai kyunki yeh parents se next generation tak features transfer karti hai.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction mein DNA copying ki importence bahut zyaada hai kyunki yeh parents se next generation tak features transfer karti hai.

gec_data.hinglish_with_error: Reproduction mein DNA copying ki importence bahut zyaada hai kyunki yeh parents se next generation tak features transfer karti hai.
gec_data.explanation: Common misspelling of 'importance' as 'importence' — the correct English spelling uses '-ance' not '-ence'.

original_english: Binary fission mein organism do equal halves mein split hota hai, jabki multiple fission mein kai daughter cells banti hain.
hinglish_roman: Binary fission mein organism do equal halves mein split hota hai, jabki multiple fission mein kai doughter cells banti hain.

gec_data.hinglish_with_error: Binary fission mein organism do equal halves mein split hota hai, jabki multiple fission mein kai doughter cells banti hain.
gec_data.explanation: Misspelling of 'daughter' as 'doughter' — confused with 'dough'. Correct biological term is 'daughter cells'.

original_english: Placenta embryo ko mother ke blood se nutrition provide karta hai aur waste substances ko bhi remove karta hai.
hinglish_roman: Placenta embryo ko mother ke blood se nutrition provide karta hai aur waste substences ko bhi remove karta hai.

gec_data.hinglish_with_error: Placenta embryo ko mother ke blood se nutrition provide karta hai aur waste substences ko bhi remove karta hai.
gec_data.explanation: Misspelling of 'substances' as 'substences' — common vowel confusion. The correct spelling is 'substances'.

original_english: Sexual reproduction mein do individuals ke DNA combine hota hai jisse naye combinations of variants bante hain.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction mein do individuals ke DNA combine hota hai jisse naye combinetion of variants bante hain.

gec_data.hinglish_with_error: Sexual reproduction mein do individuals ke DNA combine hota hai jisse naye combinetion of variants bante hain.
gec_data.explanation: Misspelling of 'combination' as 'combinetion' — student confused the root word 'combine' with the noun form. Correct spelling is 'combination'.

original_english: Contraceptive methods mein condoms, oral pills aur copper-T jaise devices shamil hain jo pregnancy avoid karne mein madad karte hain.
hinglish_roman: Contreceptive methods mein condoms, oral pills aur copper-T jaise devices shamil hain jo pregnancy avoid karne mein madad karte hain.

gec_data.hinglish_with_error: Contreceptive methods mein condoms, oral pills aur copper-T jaise devices shamil hain jo pregnancy avoid karne mein madad karte hain.
gec_data.explanation: Misspelling of 'Contraceptive' as 'Contreceptive' — the prefix is 'contra-' (meaning against), not 'contre-'. Correct term is 'Contraceptive'.

original_english: Variations arising during the process of reproduction can be inherited.
hinglish_roman: Reproduction ke process ke dauran jo variations aate hain, woh inherit ho sakte hain.

original_english: The rules of heredity determine the process by which traits and characteristics are reliably inherited.
hinglish_roman: Heredity ke rules determine karte hain ki traits aur characteristics kis tarah reliably inherit hoti hain.

original_english: Mendel used pea plants with different characteristics such as tall and short plants to study inheritance.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne alag-alag characteristics wale pea plants use kiye jaise tall aur short plants, inheritance study karne ke liye.

original_english: In the F1 generation, all plants were tall and there were no halfway characteristics.
hinglish_roman: F1 generation mein saare plants tall the aur koi bhi halfway characteristics nahi thi.

original_english: In the F2 generation, one quarter of the plants were short, showing that the shortness trait was hidden in F1.
hinglish_roman: F2 generation mein ek chaurthai plants short the, jisse pata chala ki shortness trait F1 mein chhupa hua tha.

original_english: Mendel proposed that two copies of a factor, now called genes, control each trait in sexually reproducing organisms.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne propose kiya ki do copies ek factor ki, jo ab genes kehlaate hain, har trait ko control karti hain sexually reproducing organisms mein.

original_english: A trait like tallness that is expressed even with one copy is called a dominant trait.
hinglish_roman: Ek trait jaise tallness jo sirf ek copy se bhi express hoti hai, use dominant trait kehte hain.

original_english: A recessive trait is only expressed when both copies of the gene are recessive.
hinglish_roman: Recessive trait tab hi express hoti hai jab dono gene copies recessive hon.

original_english: Both TT and Tt represent tall plants, while only tt represents a short plant.
hinglish_roman: TT aur Tt dono tall plants ko represent karte hain, jabki sirf tt ek short plant ko represent karta hai.

original_english: When two traits are studied together, they are inherited independently of each other.
hinglish_roman: Jab do traits ko saath mein study kiya jaata hai, toh woh ek doosre se independently inherit hote hain.

original_english: In the dihybrid cross, F2 offspring showed a 9:3:3:1 ratio of different trait combinations.
hinglish_roman: Dihybrid cross mein, F2 offspring ne alag-alag trait combinations ka 9:3:3:1 ratio dikhaya.

original_english: Genes control characteristics by coding for proteins such as enzymes that regulate biological processes.
hinglish_roman: Genes characteristics ko control karte hain proteins ke liye code karke, jaise enzymes jo biological processes ko regulate karte hain.

original_english: Plant height depends on the amount of a particular plant hormone, which depends on the efficiency of the enzyme producing it.
hinglish_roman: Plant ki height ek khaas plant hormone ki quantity par depend karti hai, jo uss enzyme ki efficiency par depend karta hai jo use produce karta hai.

original_english: Both parents contribute equally to the DNA of the progeny during sexual reproduction.
hinglish_roman: Sexual reproduction mein dono parents progeny ke DNA mein barabar contribution dete hain.

original_english: Each pea plant must have two sets of all genes, one inherited from each parent.
hinglish_roman: Har pea plant mein saare genes ke do sets hone chahiye, ek ek parent se inherit hua.

original_english: Each gene set is present as separate independent pieces called chromosomes, not as a single long thread of DNA.
hinglish_roman: Har gene set alag independent pieces ke roop mein hota hai jo chromosomes kehlaate hain, na ki ek lambi DNA thread ke roop mein.

original_english: Each cell has two copies of each chromosome, one each from the male and female parents.
hinglish_roman: Har cell mein har chromosome ki do copies hoti hain, ek male parent se aur ek female parent se.

original_english: Every germ cell will take one chromosome from each pair, which may be of either maternal or paternal origin.
hinglish_roman: Har germ cell har pair se ek chromosome leti hai, jo maternal ya paternal origin ki ho sakti hai.

original_english: When two germ cells combine, they restore the normal number of chromosomes in the progeny.
hinglish_roman: Jab do germ cells combine hoti hain, toh woh progeny mein chromosomes ki normal number restore kar deti hain.

original_english: Human beings have 22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes.
hinglish_roman: Insaanon mein 22 pairs autosomes hote hain aur ek pair sex chromosomes ka hota hai.

original_english: Women have two X chromosomes, while men have one X and one Y chromosome.
hinglish_roman: Auraton mein do X chromosomes hote hain, jabki mardon mein ek X aur ek Y chromosome hota hai.

original_english: The sex of a child is determined by what chromosome they inherit from their father.
