hinglish_roman: Bacche ka sex is baat par depend karta hai ki use apne baap se kaun sa chromosome mila.

original_english: A child who inherits an X chromosome from her father will be a girl.
hinglish_roman: Jo bacha apne baap se X chromosome inherit karta hai woh ladki hogi.

original_english: A child who inherits a Y chromosome from his father will be a boy.
hinglish_roman: Jo bacha apne baap se Y chromosome inherit karta hai woh ladka hoga.

original_english: All children will inherit an X chromosome from their mother regardless of whether they are boys or girls.
hinglish_roman: Saare bacche apni maa se ek X chromosome zaroor inherit karte hain chahe woh ladka ho ya ladki.

original_english: In some reptiles, the temperature at which fertilised eggs are kept determines whether animals will be male or female.
hinglish_roman: Kuch reptiles mein, jis temperature par fertilised eggs rakhe jaate hain, uss se tay hota hai ki janwar male hoga ya female.

original_english: In snails, individuals can change sex, indicating that sex is not genetically determined.
hinglish_roman: Snails mein, individuals apna sex badal sakte hain, jo batata hai ki sex genetically determined nahi hota.

original_english: Inheritance from the previous generation provides both a common basic body design and subtle changes for the next generation.
hinglish_roman: Pichhli generation se inheritance dono cheezein provide karti hai — ek common basic body design aur subtle changes jo agli generation ke liye hote hain.

original_english: If sexual reproduction is involved, even greater diversity will be generated across generations.
hinglish_roman: Agar sexual reproduction involved ho, toh generations mein aur bhi zyada diversity generate hogi.

original_english: Bacteria that can withstand heat will survive better in a heat wave, showing how environment selects variants.
hinglish_roman: Jo bacteria heat bardaasht kar sakte hain woh heat wave mein better survive karte hain, jisse pata chalta hai ki environment variants ko select karta hai.

original_english: Mendel was educated in a monastery and studied science and mathematics at the University of Vienna.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ki padhai ek monastery mein hui thi aur unhone University of Vienna mein science aur mathematics padha.

original_english: Mendel was the first to keep count of individuals exhibiting a particular trait in each generation.
hinglish_roman: Mendel pehle scientist the jinhone har generation mein ek particular trait dikhane wale individuals ko count kiya.

original_english: Tallness and round seeds are dominant traits in pea plants.
hinglish_roman: Tallness aur round seeds pea plants mein dominant traits hain.

original_english: New combinations of traits appear in F2 offspring when factors controlling seed shape and colour recombine.
hinglish_roman: F2 offspring mein nayi trait combinations tab aati hain jab seed shape aur colour control karne wale factors recombine karte hain.

original_english: A section of DNA that provides information for one protein is called the gene for that protein.
hinglish_roman: DNA ka woh section jo ek protein ke liye information provide karta hai, use uss protein ka gene kehte hain.

original_english: If an enzyme works efficiently, a lot of hormone will be made and the plant will be tall.
hinglish_roman: Agar enzyme efficiently kaam kare, toh zyada hormone banega aur plant tall hoga.

original_english: If the gene for an enzyme has an alteration, the enzyme becomes less efficient and less hormone is produced.
hinglish_roman: Agar kisi enzyme ke gene mein alteration ho jaaye, toh woh enzyme kam efficient ho jaata hai aur kam hormone produce hota hai.

original_english: The sex chromosome pair in men is a mismatched pair where one is a normal X while the other is a short Y.
hinglish_roman: Mardon mein sex chromosome pair ek mismatched pair hota hai jahan ek normal X hota hai aur doosra ek chota Y hota hai.

original_english: Human populations show a great deal of variation among different individuals.
hinglish_roman: Human populations mein alag-alag individuals ke beech kaafi variation dekha jaata hai.

original_english: Free and attached earlobes are two variants found in human populations.
hinglish_roman: Free aur attached earlobes human populations mein paaye jaane wale do variants hain.

original_english: Both the father and mother contribute practically equal amounts of genetic material to the child.
hinglish_roman: Baap aur maa dono practically barabar matra mein genetic material bacche ko dete hain.

original_english: For each trait there will be two versions in each child, one from each parent.
hinglish_roman: Har trait ke liye har bacche mein do versions hote hain, ek ek parent se.

original_english: Asexual reproduction produces very little variation because differences arise only from small inaccuracies in DNA copying.
hinglish_roman: Asexual reproduction mein bahut kam variation hoti hai kyunki differences sirf DNA copying mein chhoti galtiyon se aate hain.

original_english: Selection of variants by environmental factors forms the basis for evolutionary processes.
hinglish_roman: Environmental factors dwara variants ka selection evolutionary processes ka aadhaar banta hai.

original_english: Sexually reproducing individuals have two copies of genes for the same trait.
hinglish_roman: Sexually reproducing individuals mein ek hi trait ke liye genes ki do copies hoti hain.

original_english: If the copies of a gene are not identical, the trait that gets expressed is called the dominant trait.
hinglish_roman: Agar gene ki copies identical nahi hain, toh jo trait express hoti hai use dominant trait kehte hain.

original_english: The other trait that is hidden when a dominant trait is present is called the recessive trait.
hinglish_roman: Jo doosri trait dominant trait ki maujoodgi mein chhup jaati hai use recessive trait kehte hain.

original_english: Traits in one individual may be inherited separately, giving rise to new combinations of traits in offspring.
hinglish_roman: Ek individual mein traits alag-alag inherit ho sakti hain, jisse offspring mein nayi combinations banti hain.

original_english: In human beings, the sex of the individual is largely genetically determined.
hinglish_roman: Insaanon mein, kisi individual ka sex zyaadatar genetically determine hota hai.

original_english: The genes inherited from our parents decide whether we will be boys or girls.
hinglish_roman: Hamare parents se inherit hone wale genes decide karte hain ki hum ladke honge ya ladkiyaan.

original_english: Mendel crossed a tall plant and a short plant and found that all F1 progeny were tall.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne ek tall plant aur ek short plant ko cross karaya aur paya ki saare F1 progeny tall the.

original_english: Self-pollination of F1 tall plants produces both tall and short plants in F2 generation.
hinglish_roman: F1 tall plants ke self-pollination se F2 generation mein tall aur short dono tarah ke plants bante hain.

original_english: A child resembles its parents but is not exactly the same due to genetic variations produced by meiosis.
hinglish_roman: Bacha apne parents se milta julta hai lekin meiosis se hone wali genetic variations ki wajah se bilkul wahi nahi hota.

original_english: In a sugarcane field, very little variation is seen among the individual plants.
hinglish_roman: Ganne ke khet mein alag-alag plants ke beech bahut kam variation dikhayi deti hai.

original_english: The two characteristics of round seeds and wrinkled seeds are controlled by separate gene pairs.
hinglish_roman: Round seeds aur wrinkled seeds ki do characteristics alag-alag gene pairs se control hoti hain.

original_english: Cellular DNA is the information source for making proteins in the cell.
hinglish_roman: Cellular DNA cell mein proteins banane ka information source hota hai.

original_english: Every germ cell must have only one gene set so that when two germ cells combine, the normal number is restored.
hinglish_roman: Har germ cell mein sirf ek gene set hona chahiye taaki jab do germ cells combine hon toh normal number restore ho sake.

original_english: The Mendelian mechanism of inheritance is used by all sexually reproducing organisms.
hinglish_roman: Mendelian inheritance ka mechanism saare sexually reproducing organisms use karte hain.

original_english: In a Mendelian experiment with two traits, the F1 progeny all had round seeds and were tall.
hinglish_roman: Do traits wale Mendelian experiment mein, saare F1 progeny ke seeds round the aur woh tall bhi the.

original_english: Mendel blended his knowledge of science and mathematics to arrive at the laws of inheritance.
hinglish_roman: Mendel ne science aur mathematics ki apni knowledge ko milaakar inheritance ke laws tak pahunche.

original_english: Half the children will be boys and half will be girls based on sex chromosome inheritance.
hinglish_roman: Sex chromosome inheritance ke basis par aadhe bacche ladke honge aur aadhe ladkiyaan.

original_english: Variations promote survival by allowing some individuals to be better suited to changing environments.
hinglish_roman: Variations survival ko promote karte hain kyunki kuch individuals changing environments ke liye zyada suitable hote hain.

original_english: The law of segregation states that the two alleles for a trait separate during gamete formation.
hinglish_roman: Law of segregation kehta hai ki kisi trait ke do alleles gamete banane ke waqt alag ho jaate hain.

original_english: The law of independent assortment states that genes for different traits are inherited independently.
hinglish_roman: Law of independent assortment kehta hai ki alag-alag traits ke genes independently inherit hote hain.

original_english: If a trait A exists in 10 percent of a population it likely arose more recently than a trait existing in 60 percent.
hinglish_roman: Agar koi trait A, population ke 10 percent mein hai, toh woh probably uss trait se zyada recently aaya hai jo 60 percent mein hai.

original_english: Gametes are formed by meiosis, which ensures each gamete carries only half the chromosome number.
hinglish_roman: Gametes meiosis se bante hain, jisse ensure hota hai ki har gamete mein sirf aadhi chromosome number ho.

original_english: A test cross is performed to verify the genotype of a plant showing the dominant phenotype.
hinglish_roman: Test cross tab kiya jaata hai jab dominant phenotype dikhane wale plant ka genotype verify karna hota hai.

original_english: Phenotype refers to the physical expression of a trait, while genotype refers to the genetic makeup.
hinglish_roman: Phenotype trait ki physical expression hoti hai, jabki genotype genetic makeup ko refer karta hai.

original_english: Homozygous organisms have two identical copies of a gene, while heterozygous organisms have two different copies.
hinglish_roman: Homozygous organisms mein gene ki do identical copies hoti hain, jabki heterozygous organisms mein do alag copies hoti hain.

original_english: The stability of the DNA of a species is maintained through the mechanism of sexual reproduction.
hinglish_roman: Kisi species ke DNA ki stability sexual reproduction ke mechanism ke zariye maintain hoti hai.

original_english: In a monohybrid cross, a 3:1 ratio is observed in the F2 generation.
hinglish_roman: Monohybrid cross mein, F2 generation mein 3:1 ratio dekha jaata hai.

original_english: The 1:2:1 ratio in F2 represents TT, Tt, and tt genotype combinations.
hinglish_roman: F2 mein 1:2:1 ratio TT, Tt aur tt genotype combinations ko represent karta hai.

original_english: The second generation progeny of F1 tall plants are not all tall — one quarter of them are short.

original_english: Genes control the characteristics of an organism by coding for proteins.

original_english: All the interacting organisms in an area together with the non-living constituents of the environment form an ecosystem.
hinglish_roman: Kisi area ke saare interacting organisms aur environment ke non-living hisse milkar ek ecosystem banate hain.

original_english: An ecosystem consists of biotic components comprising living organisms and abiotic components comprising physical factors.
hinglish_roman: Ecosystem mein biotic components hote hain jo living organisms se bane hote hain aur abiotic components hote hain jo physical factors se.

original_english: Abiotic components include physical factors like temperature, rainfall, wind, soil and minerals.
hinglish_roman: Abiotic components mein temperature, rainfall, wind, mitti aur minerals jaise physical factors aate hain.

original_english: Natural ecosystems are forests, ponds and lakes while gardens and crop-fields are human-made ecosystems.
hinglish_roman: Forests, taalaab aur jheel natural ecosystems hain jabki gardens aur khet human-made ecosystems hain.

original_english: All green plants and certain bacteria which can produce food by photosynthesis are called producers.
hinglish_roman: Saare harey paudhe aur kuch bacteria jo photosynthesis se khana bana sakte hain unhe producers kehte hain.

original_english: Producers make organic compounds like sugar and starch from inorganic substances using the radiant energy of the Sun.
hinglish_roman: Producers Surya ki radiant energy use karke inorganic substances se sugar aur starch jaise organic compounds banate hain.

original_english: Organisms which consume the food produced either directly from producers or indirectly by feeding on other consumers are called consumers.
hinglish_roman: Jo organisms producers se seedha ya doosre consumers ko khakar khana prapt karte hain unhe consumers kehte hain.

original_english: Consumers can be classified as herbivores, carnivores, omnivores and parasites.
hinglish_roman: Consumers ko herbivores, carnivores, omnivores aur parasites mein classify kiya ja sakta hai.

original_english: Microorganisms comprising bacteria and fungi break down the dead remains and waste products of organisms.
hinglish_roman: Bacteria aur fungi jaise microorganisms organisms ke dead remains aur waste products ko tod dete hain.

original_english: Decomposers break down complex organic substances into simple inorganic substances that go into the soil.
hinglish_roman: Decomposers complex organic substances ko simple inorganic substances mein tod dete hain jo mitti mein chali jaati hain.

original_english: A series of organisms taking part at various biotic levels form a food chain.
hinglish_roman: Alag-alag biotic levels par hissedari karne wale organisms ki ek series food chain banati hai.

original_english: Each step or level of the food chain forms a trophic level.
hinglish_roman: Food chain ka har step ya level ek trophic level banata hai.

original_english: The autotrophs or producers are at the first trophic level and fix up solar energy for heterotrophs.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs ya producers pehle trophic level par hote hain aur heterotrophs ke liye solar energy fix karte hain.

original_english: Herbivores or primary consumers come at the second trophic level.
hinglish_roman: Herbivores ya primary consumers doosre trophic level par aate hain.

original_english: Small carnivores or secondary consumers are at the third trophic level and larger carnivores form the fourth.
hinglish_roman: Chhote carnivores ya secondary consumers teesre trophic level par hote hain aur bade carnivores chauthe trophic level par.

original_english: Green plants in a terrestrial ecosystem capture about 1% of the energy of sunlight that falls on their leaves.

original_english: An average of 10% of the food eaten is turned into the organism's own body and made available for the next level of consumers.

original_english: Since so little energy is available for the next level, food chains generally consist of only three or four steps.

original_english: There are generally a greater number of individuals at the lower trophic levels of an ecosystem.

original_english: Each organism is generally eaten by two or more other kinds of organisms forming a food web instead of a straight food chain.

original_english: The flow of energy in an ecosystem is unidirectional.

original_english: Decomposers break down dead organisms into simple inorganic substances.
hinglish_roman: Decomposers mare hue organisms ko simple inorganic substances mein tod dete hain.
hinglish_with_error: Decomposers mare hue organisms ko simple inorganic substances mein todti hain.
gec_explanation: 'Decomposers' is treated as masculine or gender-neutral plural in code-mixed Hindi usage. 'Todti hain' is the feminine plural form and is grammatically incorrect. The correct form is 'tod dete hain' using the masculine auxiliary, consistent with the gender-neutral subject 'decomposers'.

original_english: Ozone layer protects the Earth from harmful UV radiation.
hinglish_roman: Ozone layer dharti ko haanikaarak UV radiation se bachata hai.
hinglish_with_error: Ozone layer dharti ko haanikaarak UV radiation se bachati hai.
gec_explanation: In Hindi, 'layer' (or 'ozone layer' as a compound noun) is treated as masculine in common code-mixed usage, similar to how borrowed English nouns default to masculine. 'Bachati hai' is a feminine auxiliary form and is incorrect here. The correct auxiliary is 'bachata hai' (masculine).

original_english: Food chains generally consist of only three or four trophic levels.
hinglish_roman: Food chains mein aamtaur par sirf teen ya chaar trophic levels hote hain.
hinglish_with_error: Food chains mein aamtaur par sirf teen ya chaar trophic levels hota hain.
gec_explanation: 'Trophic levels' is plural, so the Hindi auxiliary must also be in plural form. 'Hota hain' mixes singular 'hota' with plural 'hain', which is a number agreement error. The correct form is 'hote hain' where both the participle and the auxiliary are in plural form.

original_english: CFCs are released into the atmosphere and cause depletion of the ozone layer.
hinglish_roman: CFCs atmosphere mein release hote hain aur ozone layer ko khatam karte hain.
hinglish_with_error: CFCs atmosphere mein released hote hain aur ozone layer ko khatam karte hain.
gec_explanation: When an English verb is used before a Hindi auxiliary like 'hote hain', it must remain in its base/uninflected form. 'Released' is the past participle form of the verb and is incorrect in this compound Hindi-English construction. The correct usage is 'release hote hain' with the base verb form.

original_english: Biological magnification causes pesticides to accumulate more at higher trophic levels.
hinglish_roman: Biological magnification ki wajah se pesticides upar ke trophic levels mein zyada accumulate hote hain.
hinglish_with_error: Biological magnification ki wajah se pesticides upar ke trophic levels mein zyada accumulates hote hain.
gec_explanation: In code-mixed Hinglish, when an English verb precedes the Hindi auxiliary 'hote hain', it must appear in its base form without any English inflection. 'Accumulates' adds a third-person singular '-s' suffix which is redundant and incorrect because tense and agreement are already conveyed by 'hote hain'. The correct form is 'accumulate hote hain'.

chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Hot springs in Puga Valley in Ladakh maintain very high temperatures even in a cold climate.
hinglish_roman: Ladakh ke Puga Valley ke hot springs thande climate mein bhi bahut zyada temperature maintain karte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The organisms living in these hot springs are mostly heat-loving bacteria called thermophiles, which are unicellular.

original_english: Calcium carbonate formed rapidly around hot springs and may have helped in the formation of the first protective membrane.
hinglish_roman: Hot springs ke aas-paas calcium carbonate tezi se banta tha aur shayad pehli protective membrane ke formation mein madad ki hogi.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: All living organisms are made up of cells and the cell represents the basic level at which life exists.
hinglish_roman: Saare living organisms cells se bane hote hain aur cell woh basic level hai jahan life exist karti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Some organisms like bacteria or yeast consist of only one cell and are called unicellular organisms.
hinglish_roman: Bacteria ya yeast jaise kuch organisms sirf ek cell se milkar bane hote hain aur inhe unicellular organisms kaha jaata hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Plants, fish, birds, or humans are made up of millions of cells that work together and are called multicellular organisms.
hinglish_roman: Paudhe, machhliyan, pakshi ya insaan millions of cells se milkar bane hote hain jo ek saath kaam karte hain, inhe multicellular organisms kehte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: A group of similar cells performing similar functions forms tissues.
hinglish_roman: Ek jaisi functions karne wale similar cells ka group milkar tissue banaata hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Different tissues are organised to form an organ and several organs work together to form organ systems.
hinglish_roman: Alag-alag tissues milkar ek organ banate hain aur kai organs milkar organ system banaate hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The limit of resolution of the human eye is 0.1 mm, meaning two points closer than this appear as a single point.
hinglish_roman: Human eye ki resolution limit 0.1 mm hoti hai, matlab agar do points isse zyada paas hon toh woh ek single point lagte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Robert Hooke was the first person to observe a cell in 1665 using a self-designed microscope.
hinglish_roman: Robert Hooke ne 1665 mein apne banaye hue microscope se pehli baar cell observe kiya tha.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: While examining a thin slice of cork, Hooke observed small box-like compartments and named them cells.
hinglish_roman: Cork ki얇i slice examine karte waqt Hooke ne chote box-jaisi compartments dekhi aur unhe cells naam diya.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Scientists improved the microscope by improving its three main features — resolution, contrast, and magnification.
hinglish_roman: Scientists ne microscope ko uske teen main features — resolution, contrast, aur magnification — ko improve karke behtar banaya.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Electron microscopes use a beam of electrons instead of light to produce highly magnified images at the nanometre scale.
hinglish_roman: Electron microscopes light ki jagah electrons ki beam use karte hain aur nanometre scale par highly magnified images produce karte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The cell membrane is a thin boundary that surrounds a cell and protects its contents.
hinglish_roman: Cell membrane ek patli boundary hoti hai jo cell ko gherta hai aur uske contents ki suraksha karti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The cell membrane is selectively permeable, which means it allows some substances to pass through it while blocking others.
hinglish_roman: Cell membrane selectively permeable hoti hai, yaani yeh kuch substances ko andar aane deti hai aur doosron ko rok deti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Osmosis is the movement of water through a selectively permeable membrane from a region of lower solute concentration to higher solute concentration.
hinglish_roman: Osmosis ek aisi process hai jisme paani selectively permeable membrane ke zariye kam solute concentration wali jagah se zyada solute concentration wali jagah ki taraf move karta hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Diffusion is the net movement of particles from a higher to a lower concentration even without a membrane.
hinglish_roman: Diffusion mein particles bina membrane ke bhi zyada concentration wali jagah se kam concentration wali jagah ki taraf move karte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The cell membrane is made up of lipids and proteins and is about 7 to 10 nanometres thick.
hinglish_roman: Cell membrane lipids aur proteins se bani hoti hai aur iska thickness lagbhag 7 se 10 nanometres hota hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The fluid-mosaic model explains that the membrane has a lipid bilayer with proteins embedded in it.
hinglish_roman: Fluid-mosaic model yeh explain karta hai ki membrane mein ek lipid bilayer hota hai jisme proteins embedded hote hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: In the lipid bilayer, the water-attracting heads face outward and the water-repelling tails face inward.
hinglish_roman: Lipid bilayer mein paani ko attract karne wale heads bahar ki taraf hote hain aur paani ko repel karne wale tails andar ki taraf hote hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Plant, fungi, and bacteria cells have an additional layer called the cell wall outside the cell membrane.
hinglish_roman: Paudhon, fungi, aur bacteria ke cells mein cell membrane ke bahar ek aur layer hoti hai jise cell wall kehte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The plant cell wall is primarily made of cellulose, a type of carbohydrate formed by many glucose units linked together.
hinglish_roman: Plant cell wall mainly cellulose se bani hoti hai, jo ek tarah ka carbohydrate hai jo kaafi glucose units ke aapas mein jude hone se banta hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: When a plant cell is placed in a concentrated sugar solution, the inner content shrinks while the cell wall maintains the outer shape.
hinglish_roman: Jab plant cell ko concentrated sugar solution mein rakha jaata hai, toh andar ka content shrink kar jaata hai lekin cell wall bahar ka shape maintain karti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Animal cells do not have a cell wall, so they can change shape easily and support tissue movement.
hinglish_roman: Animal cells mein cell wall nahi hoti, isliye woh aasaani se shape change kar sakti hain aur tissue movement mein madad karti hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: A bacterial cell lacks a well-defined nucleus and membrane-bound organelles and is called a prokaryotic cell.
hinglish_roman: Bacterial cell mein well-defined nucleus aur membrane-bound organelles nahi hote, aur ise prokaryotic cell kaha jaata hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Plant and animal cells have a well-defined nucleus and several membrane-bound organelles and are called eukaryotic cells.
hinglish_roman: Plant aur animal cells mein well-defined nucleus aur kaafi membrane-bound organelles hote hain, inhe eukaryotic cells kehte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The nucleus has a double-layered covering called the nuclear membrane, which has pores that allow material transfer between the nucleus and the cytoplasm.
hinglish_roman: Nucleus ke upar double-layered covering hoti hai jise nuclear membrane kehte hain, isme pores hote hain jo nucleus aur cytoplasm ke beech material transfer allow karte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The nucleolus is the dense round body in the nucleus where synthesis of ribosomal subunits takes place.
hinglish_roman: Nucleolus nucleus ke andar ek ghani golaakar structure hoti hai jahan ribosomal subunits ka synthesis hota hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Chromosomes contain information for inheritance of characters from parents to the next generation in the form of DNA molecules.
hinglish_roman: Chromosomes mein DNA molecules ke roop mein genetic information hoti hai jo parents se next generation ko milti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The functional segments of DNA are called genes and they carry genetic information.
hinglish_roman: DNA ke functional segments ko genes kehte hain aur yeh genetic information carry karte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Mature Red Blood Cells in humans do not have a nucleus, which provides more space for haemoglobin to carry oxygen.
hinglish_roman: Insano mein mature Red Blood Cells mein nucleus nahi hota, jis wajah se haemoglobin ke liye zyada jagah milti hai aur woh zyada oxygen carry kar sakti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Ribosomes are tiny structures that may be present freely in the cytoplasm or attached to the endoplasmic reticulum and are the sites of protein synthesis.
hinglish_roman: Ribosomes choti structures hoti hain jo cytoplasm mein freely ya endoplasmic reticulum se attached ho sakti hain aur protein synthesis ka kaam karti hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The Endoplasmic Reticulum is a large organelle that spreads like a network within the cytoplasm.
hinglish_roman: Endoplasmic Reticulum ek bada organelle hai jo cytoplasm ke andar ek network ki tarah failaa hota hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum has ribosomes on its surface and is mainly involved in protein synthesis and secretion.
hinglish_roman: Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum ki surface par ribosomes hote hain aur yeh mainly protein synthesis aur secretion mein involved hoti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum does not have ribosomes and is involved in the synthesis and storage of fats and hormones.
hinglish_roman: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum mein ribosomes nahi hote aur yeh fats aur hormones ke synthesis aur storage mein kaam aati hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The Golgi apparatus modifies, sorts, and packages proteins and lipids into vesicles for transport or secretion.
hinglish_roman: Golgi apparatus proteins aur lipids ko modify, sort aur package karke vesicles mein daalata hai taaki unhe transport ya secrete kiya ja sake.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Lysosomes are single membrane-bound sacs filled with enzymes that break down unwanted proteins, carbohydrates, and fats.
hinglish_roman: Lysosomes single membrane se ghire hue sacs hote hain jinme enzymes bhari hoti hain jo unwanted proteins, carbohydrates aur fats ko tod deti hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Mitochondria are called the powerhouses of the cell because they supply energy needed for most cellular activities.
hinglish_roman: Mitochondria ko cell ka powerhouse kaha jaata hai kyunki yeh zyaadatar cellular activities ke liye zaruri energy supply karte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Each mitochondrion is surrounded by two membranes, with the inner membrane folded into cristae to increase surface area.
hinglish_roman: Har ek mitochondrion do membranes se ghira hota hai, jisme inner membrane cristae mein fold hoti hai taaki surface area badh sake.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: In mitochondria, glucose is broken down during cellular respiration and energy is stored as ATP.
hinglish_roman: Mitochondria mein cellular respiration ke dauran glucose toot ta hai aur energy ATP ke roop mein store hoti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: ATP acts as the energy currency of the cell and is used for most cellular activities.
hinglish_roman: ATP cell ki energy currency ki tarah kaam karta hai aur zyaadatar cellular activities ke liye use hota hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Plastids are special organelles in plant cells used for food synthesis and storage.
hinglish_roman: Plastids plant cells mein special organelles hote hain jo food synthesis aur storage ke liye use hote hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Chloroplasts contain a green pigment called chlorophyll that absorbs sunlight for photosynthesis.
hinglish_roman: Chloroplasts mein chlorophyll naam ka green pigment hota hai jo photosynthesis ke liye sunlight absorb karta hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Chloroplasts are double-membrane-bound organelles and contain a semi-fluid substance called stroma.
hinglish_roman: Chloroplasts double-membrane se ghire organelles hote hain aur inke andar stroma naam ka semi-fluid substance hota hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Chromoplasts are plastids that contain pigments like yellow, orange, or red and are responsible for bright colours in flowers and fruits.
hinglish_roman: Chromoplasts woh plastids hain jinme yellow, orange ya red jaisi pigments hoti hain aur yeh phoolon aur phalon ke bright colours ke liye zimmedaar hote hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Leucoplasts are colourless plastids that store food material such as starch, oils, or proteins.
hinglish_roman: Leucoplasts rangheen nahi hote, yeh colourless plastids hote hain jo starch, oils ya proteins jaisa food store karte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Mitochondria and plastids have their own DNA and ribosomes suggesting they share an evolutionary history with bacteria.
hinglish_roman: Mitochondria aur plastids ke paas apna DNA aur ribosomes hote hain, jo yeh suggest karta hai ki inका bacteria ke saath evolutionary connection raha hoga.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: In a mature plant cell, there is usually one large central vacuole surrounded by a selectively permeable membrane filled with cell sap.
hinglish_roman: Ek mature plant cell mein aam taur par ek bada central vacuole hota hai jo selectively permeable membrane se ghira hota hai aur cell sap se bhara hota hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: The vacuole stores water, minerals, sugars, and waste material and helps maintain pressure inside the cell.
hinglish_roman: Vacuole mein paani, minerals, sugars aur waste material store hota hai aur yeh cell ke andar pressure maintain karne mein madad karta hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: When a plant does not get enough water, the vacuole loses water and the plant gets wilted.
hinglish_roman: Jab paudhe ko paafi paani nahi milta, toh vacuole paani kho deta hai aur paudha murjha jaata hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: In eukaryotic cells, a network of fine fibres forms the cytoskeleton which provides structural support and enables cell movement.
hinglish_roman: Eukaryotic cells mein fine fibres ka ek network hota hai jise cytoskeleton kehte hain, yeh structural support deta hai aur cell movement mein bhi madad karta hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Cell division is the process by which new cells are formed from pre-existing cells.
hinglish_roman: Cell division woh process hai jisme naye cells pehle se existing cells se bante hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Cell division allows living organisms to grow, repair damaged tissues, and reproduce.
hinglish_roman: Cell division ki wajah se living organisms grow kar sakte hain, damaged tissues repair ho sakti hain aur reproduction bhi hota hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Mitosis produces two genetically identical daughter cells from one parent cell with the same number of chromosomes.
hinglish_roman: Mitosis mein ek parent cell se do genetically identical daughter cells bante hain jinme chromosomes ki same sankhya hoti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Mitosis is important for normal growth, repair, maintenance, and asexual reproduction.
hinglish_roman: Mitosis normal growth, repair, maintenance aur asexual reproduction ke liye zaroori hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Meiosis is a type of cell division that produces gametes and occurs only in the cells of reproductive organs.
hinglish_roman: Meiosis ek aisi cell division hai jo gametes produce karti hai aur sirf reproductive organs ki cells mein hoti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: In meiosis, the parent cell divides twice to form four daughter cells, each having half the number of chromosomes.
hinglish_roman: Meiosis mein parent cell do baar divide hoti hai aur chaar daughter cells banti hain, jinme se har ek mein chromosomes ki adhi sankhya hoti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: During fertilisation, when gametes from two individuals combine, the original chromosome number is restored.
hinglish_roman: Fertilisation ke dauran jab do individuals ke gametes aapas mein milte hain, toh chromosomes ki original sankhya wapas aa jaati hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: In 1838, Matthias Schleiden reported that all plants are made up of cells.
hinglish_roman: 1838 mein Matthias Schleiden ne report kiya ki saare paudhe cells se bane hote hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Rudolf Virchow in 1855 stated that new cells are formed only from pre-existing cells.
hinglish_roman: Rudolf Virchow ne 1855 mein kaha ki naye cells sirf pehle se exist karne wale cells se hi bante hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

hinglish_roman: Classical Cell Theory ke mutabiq, saare living organisms cells se bane hain, cell life ki basic unit hai, aur saare cells pehle se exist karne wale cells se hi bante hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Cells grow and divide in a controlled way and eventually die when they are no longer needed.
hinglish_roman: Cells ek controlled tarike se grow aur divide karti hain aur jab inki zaroorat nahi rehti toh yeh mar jaati hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Contact inhibition is the process where cell division stops when cells come in contact with neighbouring cells.
hinglish_roman: Contact inhibition woh process hai jisme cell division ruk jaati hai jab cells apne neighbouring cells se touch karti hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Cancer cells lose contact inhibition and keep dividing uncontrollably, leading to the formation of tumours.
hinglish_roman: Cancer cells contact inhibition kho deti hain aur uncontrollably divide hoti rehti hain, jisse tumour ban jaata hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Programmed Cell Death is a genetically regulated process of selective cell destruction essential for normal development.
hinglish_roman: Programmed Cell Death ek genetically regulated process hai jisme selective cell destruction hoti hai, yeh normal development ke liye zaroori hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Errors in mitosis can lead to uncontrolled cell division, resulting in tumours and abnormal chromosome numbers.
hinglish_roman: Mitosis mein galtiyan hone se uncontrolled cell division ho sakti hai, jisse tumours aur abnormal chromosome numbers ki samsya aa sakti hai.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Errors in meiosis may result in genetic disorders associated with developmental problems or cause early pregnancy loss.
hinglish_roman: Meiosis mein galtiyan genetic disorders ko janm de sakti hain jo developmental problems se judi hoti hain ya phir pregnancy ke shuruaat mein hi loss ka kaaran ban sakti hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Cell culture is the process of growing plant and animal cells outside the body in special nutrient-rich conditions.

chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: J. Craig Venter's team created a synthetic copy of bacterial DNA and inserted it into another bacterium, which then grew following the new DNA's instructions.

chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: In plants, meiosis occurs in anthers to form pollen grains and in ovaries to produce egg cells.

chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Human sperm cells contain lysosomal enzymes that help break down the outer layer of the egg during fertilisation.

chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Mitochondria are the powerhouses of the cell and produce ATP through cellular respiration.
hinglish_roman: Mitocondria cell ka powerhouse hote hain aur cellular respirashun ke zariye ATP produce karte hain.
hinglish_corrected: Mitochondria cell ka powerhouse hote hain aur cellular respiration ke zariye ATP produce karte hain.
chapter: Cell: The Building Block of Life

original_english: Chromosomes are made up of DNA and proteins and carry genetic information.
hinglish_roman: Chromosoms DNA aur proteen se bane hote hain aur genetic informashun carry karte hain.
hinglish_corrected: Chromosomes DNA aur proteins se bane hote hain aur genetic information carry karte hain.

original_english: Ribosomes are the sites of protein synthesis in the cell.
hinglish_roman: Ribosoms cell mein protein synthasis ki site hote hain.
hinglish_corrected: Ribosomes cell mein protein synthesis ki site hote hain.

original_english: The nucleus controls all the activities of the cell and contains the genetic material.
hinglish_roman: Nucleas cell ki saari activities control karta hai aur genetic meterial contain karta hai.
hinglish_corrected: Nucleus cell ki saari activities control karta hai aur genetic material contain karta hai.

original_english: Life begins when a single cell divides itself several times to give rise to a large number of cells.
hinglish_roman: Life tab shuru hoti hai jab ek single cell kai baar divide hoke bahut saari cells banata hai.

original_english: These cells gradually form the skin, muscles, bones, nerves and all other organs.
hinglish_roman: Yeh cells dheere-dheere skin, muscles, bones, nerves aur baaki saare organs banate hain.

original_english: A tissue is a group of cells similar in structure that work together to perform a specific function.
hinglish_roman: Tissue aise cells ka group hota hai jo structure mein similar hote hain aur ek specific function perform karte hain.

original_english: In multicellular organisms, cells of similar type performing similar functions group together to form a tissue.
hinglish_roman: Multicellular organisms mein similar type ke cells jo similar functions perform karte hain, mil ke tissue banate hain.

original_english: The formation of different types of tissues leads to the division of labour, which increases efficiency.
hinglish_roman: Alag-alag types ke tissues banne se division of labour hoti hai, jisse body ki efficiency badh jaati hai.

original_english: Most plants are fixed in one place and do not move from place to place like animals.
hinglish_roman: Zyaadatar plants ek jagah fixed rehte hain aur animals ki tarah ek jagah se doosri jagah nahi jaate.

original_english: Plant cells have a cell wall that provides rigidity and strength.
hinglish_roman: Plant cells mein ek cell wall hoti hai jo unhe rigidity aur strength deti hai.

original_english: Without a rigid cell wall, animal cells can change shape easily, which helps in locomotion.
hinglish_roman: Rigid cell wall na hone ki wajah se animal cells aasaani se shape change kar sakti hain, jo locomotion mein help karta hai.

original_english: Meristematic tissue is made up of actively dividing cells.
hinglish_roman: Meristematic tissue actively divide hone waale cells se bana hota hai.

original_english: Roots grow only from their tips, which contain cells that divide continuously.
hinglish_roman: Roots sirf apni tips se hi grow karti hain, jahan continuously divide hone waale cells hote hain.

original_english: Apical meristem is located at the tips of roots and shoots, and helps plants grow in length.
hinglish_roman: Apical meristem roots aur shoots ki tips pe hota hai aur plants ko length mein grow karne mein help karta hai.

original_english: Lateral meristem is located along the circumference of stems and causes an increase in girth.
hinglish_roman: Lateral meristem stem ke circumference ke along hota hai aur stem ki girth badhata hai.

original_english: Annual growth rings on a tree trunk help scientists estimate the age of the tree.
hinglish_roman: Tree trunk ke annual growth rings dekh ke scientists tree ki age estimate kar sakte hain.

original_english: Intercalary meristem is located at the nodes and helps plants regenerate after being cut or grazed.
hinglish_roman: Intercalary meristem nodes pe hota hai aur plants ko cut ya graze hone ke baad regenerate karne mein help karta hai.

original_english: Grass grows back after being mowed because of the intercalary meristem present at the nodes of its stem.
hinglish_roman: Ghaas mow hone ke baad dobara ug aati hai kyunki uske stem ke nodes pe intercalary meristem hota hai.

original_english: Meristematic cells have thin walls, dense cytoplasm and a large prominent nucleus.
hinglish_roman: Meristematic cells ki walls thin hoti hain, cytoplasm dense hota hai aur nucleus bada aur prominent hota hai.

original_english: Meristematic cells lack vacuoles and are tightly packed with little intercellular space.
hinglish_roman: Meristematic cells mein vacuoles nahi hote aur yeh cells tightly packed hote hain jisme bahut kam intercellular space hoti hai.

original_english: Differentiation is the process by which meristematic tissue loses the ability to divide and becomes permanent tissue.
hinglish_roman: Differentiation woh process hai jisme meristematic tissue divide karne ki ability kho deta hai aur permanent tissue ban jaata hai.

original_english: Permanent tissues can be simple, composed of only one type of cell, or complex, composed of more than one type.
hinglish_roman: Permanent tissues simple ho sakte hain, jisme sirf ek type ki cells hoti hain, ya complex, jisme ek se zyada types ki cells hoti hain.

original_english: Epidermis forms the outermost layer of the plant body and protects all parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Epidermis plant body ki sabse bahari layer hoti hai aur plant ke sabhi parts ko protect karti hai.

original_english: Epidermal cells are covered with a waxy layer of cutin called cuticle, which reduces water loss.
hinglish_roman: Epidermal cells ke upar cutin ki ek waxy layer hoti hai jise cuticle kehte hain, jo water loss kam karta hai.

original_english: Root hairs increase the surface area for absorption of water and minerals from the soil.
hinglish_roman: Root hairs surface area badhate hain jisse mitti se water aur minerals absorb karna aasaan ho jaata hai.

original_english: Stomata in leaves help in gaseous exchange and also in transpiration.
hinglish_roman: Leaves mein stomata gaseous exchange mein aur transpiration mein bhi help karte hain.

original_english: Parenchyma consists of living cells with thin walls and intercellular spaces, and mainly stores food.
hinglish_roman: Parenchyma mein thin walls waale living cells hote hain jinke beech intercellular spaces hoti hain, aur yeh mainly food store karta hai.

original_english: In aquatic plants, specialised parenchyma forms air spaces that help them float.
hinglish_roman: Aquatic plants mein specialised parenchyma air spaces banata hai jisse woh plants paani mein float kar sakti hain.

original_english: Collenchyma has living cells with unevenly thickened corners due to pectin deposition.
hinglish_roman: Collenchyma mein living cells hoti hain jinke corners pectin jamne ki wajah se uneven tarike se thick ho jaate hain.

original_english: Collenchyma provides support and flexibility, allowing stems and tendrils to bend without breaking.
hinglish_roman: Collenchyma support aur flexibility deta hai, jisse stems aur tendrils bina toote jhuk sakte hain.

original_english: Sclerenchyma cells have thick walls due to lignin deposition, making them hard and strong.
hinglish_roman: Sclerenchyma cells ki walls lignin jamne ki wajah se thick hoti hain, jisse yeh cells kaafi hard aur strong hoti hain.

original_english: Sclerenchyma cells are mostly dead and are found in stems, leaf veins, and hard coverings like coconut husk.
hinglish_roman: Sclerenchyma cells zyaadatar dead hoti hain aur stems, leaf veins aur coconut husk jaise hard coverings mein milti hain.

original_english: Xylem transports water and minerals from the roots to other parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Xylem roots se paani aur minerals plant ke baaki hisson tak transport karta hai.

original_english: Xylem consists of tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma and xylem fibres.
hinglish_roman: Xylem mein tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma aur xylem fibres hote hain.

original_english: Xylem parenchyma is the only living component of xylem; tracheids, vessels and xylem fibres are dead.
hinglish_roman: Xylem parenchyma xylem ka ekelauta living component hai; tracheids, vessels aur xylem fibres dead hote hain.

original_english: Phloem transports food prepared in leaves to other parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Phloem leaves mein bana hua khaana plant ke doosre hisson tak le jaata hai.

original_english: Phloem consists of sieve tubes, companion cells, phloem parenchyma and phloem fibres.
hinglish_roman: Phloem mein sieve tubes, companion cells, phloem parenchyma aur phloem fibres hote hain.

original_english: Companion cells regulate the loading and unloading of sugars in sieve tubes.
hinglish_roman: Companion cells sieve tubes mein sugars ka loading aur unloading regulate karti hain.

original_english: Plant tissues are organised into three tissue systems: dermal, ground and vascular.
hinglish_roman: Plant tissues teen tissue systems mein organised hote hain: dermal, ground aur vascular.

original_english: The dermal tissue system forms the outer covering of the plant, protecting it and reducing water loss.
hinglish_roman: Dermal tissue system plant ki bahari covering banata hai, plant ko protect karta hai aur water loss kam karta hai.

original_english: The ground tissue system forms the main body of the plant and includes parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma.
hinglish_roman: Ground tissue system plant ka main body banata hai aur isme parenchyma, collenchyma aur sclerenchyma aate hain.

original_english: Epithelial tissue forms the outer covering of the body and lines the internal organs.
hinglish_roman: Epithelial tissue body ki bahari covering banata hai aur internal organs ko andar se line karta hai.

original_english: Epithelial tissue is composed of closely packed cells with very little space between them.
hinglish_roman: Epithelial tissue mein cells bahut closely packed hoti hain, jinke beech bahut kam space hoti hai.

original_english: Blood is a connective tissue that transports nutrients, gases and hormones throughout the body.
hinglish_roman: Blood ek connective tissue hai jo poore body mein nutrients, gases aur hormones transport karta hai.

original_english: Red blood cells contain haemoglobin, an iron-rich protein that gives blood its red colour.
hinglish_roman: Red blood cells mein haemoglobin hota hai jo ek iron-rich protein hai aur blood ko laal rang deta hai.

original_english: Platelets help in blood clotting at the site of injury.
hinglish_roman: Platelets chot ki jagah pe blood clotting mein help karte hain.

original_english: White blood cells collect at infected areas causing redness, swelling and possible pus formation.
hinglish_roman: White blood cells infected areas mein jama hote hain jisse laalipan, sujan aur kabhi-kabhi pus bhi ban jaata hai.

original_english: Bone is a hard connective tissue with a rigid matrix containing calcium and phosphorus.
hinglish_roman: Bone ek hard connective tissue hai jisme calcium aur phosphorus waala rigid matrix hota hai.

original_english: Cartilage has a soft jelly-like matrix that provides flexibility and cushions the ends of bones.
hinglish_roman: Cartilage mein soft jelly-jaisi matrix hoti hai jo flexibility deti hai aur bones ke ends ko cushion karti hai.

original_english: Tendons connect muscles to bones and transmit the force generated by muscle contraction.
hinglish_roman: Tendons muscles ko bones se connect karte hain aur muscle contraction se jo force aati hai use bone tak pahunchaate hain.

original_english: Ligaments connect bones to bones and prevent excessive movement at joints.
hinglish_roman: Ligaments bones ko bones se connect karte hain aur joints pe zyada movement rokthe hain.

original_english: Skeletal muscles are responsible for voluntary movements and are attached to the skeleton.
hinglish_roman: Skeletal muscles voluntary movements ke liye zimmedaar hote hain aur skeleton se attached hote hain.

original_english: Skeletal muscle fibres are long, cylindrical, unbranched and multinucleate with light and dark striations.
hinglish_roman: Skeletal muscle fibres lambe, cylindrical, unbranched aur multinucleate hote hain aur inme light-dark striations dikhayi deti hain.

original_english: Smooth muscles are found in organs like the stomach and intestines and control involuntary movements.
hinglish_roman: Smooth muscles stomach aur intestines jaisi jagah mein hoti hain aur involuntary movements control karti hain.

original_english: Smooth muscle cells are spindle-shaped, have a single nucleus and lack striations.
hinglish_roman: Smooth muscle cells spindle-shaped hoti hain, ek hi nucleus hota hai aur inme striations nahi hote.

original_english: Cardiac muscles are found only in the heart and work continuously without fatigue.
hinglish_roman: Cardiac muscles sirf dil mein hoti hain aur bina thake lagaataar kaam karti rehti hain.

original_english: Cardiac muscle fibres are cylindrical, branched with a single nucleus and have faint striations.
hinglish_roman: Cardiac muscle fibres cylindrical aur branched hote hain, ek nucleus hota hai aur inme halki striations hoti hain.

original_english: Nervous tissue forms the body's control and coordination network.
hinglish_roman: Nervous tissue body ke control aur coordination network ka kaam karta hai.

original_english: Neurons are the basic cells of nervous tissue, specialised to receive, process and transmit messages.
hinglish_roman: Neurons nervous tissue ki basic cells hain jo messages receive, process aur transmit karne ke liye specialised hoti hain.

original_english: Each neuron has three main parts: a cell body, dendrites and an axon.
hinglish_roman: Har neuron ke teen main parts hote hain: cell body, dendrites aur axon.

original_english: Dendrites receive signals from other neurons, while the axon carries messages away from the cell body.
hinglish_roman: Dendrites doosre neurons se signals receive karte hain, jabki axon messages cell body se door le jaata hai.

original_english: The musculoskeletal system consists of bones, muscles, joints, cartilage, tendons and ligaments.
hinglish_roman: Musculoskeletal system mein bones, muscles, joints, cartilage, tendons aur ligaments aate hain.

original_english: The adult human skeleton makes up about 12 to 15 percent of body weight.
hinglish_roman: Ek adult insaan ka skeleton body weight ka lagbhag 12 se 15 percent hota hai.

original_english: The ball and socket joint at the shoulder allows movement forward, backward, sideways and in circles.
hinglish_roman: Shoulder pe ball and socket joint hoti hai jo aage, peeche, side mein aur gol-gol movement allow karta hai.

original_english: Hinge joints, like those in the elbow and knee, allow bending in only one direction.
hinglish_roman: Hinge joints, jaise elbow aur knee mein hoti hain, sirf ek direction mein jhukne deti hain.

original_english: The pivot joint connecting the skull to the backbone allows the head to move side to side.
hinglish_roman: Khopdi aur backbone ko jodhne waala pivot joint sar ko ek taraf se doosri taraf hilane deta hai.

original_english: The bones of the skull are connected by fixed joints, which keep the brain safe.
hinglish_roman: Khopdi ki bones fixed joints se judi hoti hain, jo brain ko surakshit rakhti hain.

original_english: The vertebral column or backbone is made up of small bones called vertebrae.
hinglish_roman: Vertebral column ya backbone chote-chote bones se bana hota hai jinhe vertebrae kehte hain.

original_english: Between each vertebra is a cartilage disc that acts as a cushion and allows flexibility.
hinglish_roman: Har do vertebrae ke beech ek cartilage disc hoti hai jo cushion ki tarah kaam karti hai aur flexibility deti hai.

original_english: The rib cage consists of 12 pairs of ribs and protects vital organs like the heart and lungs.
hinglish_roman: Rib cage mein 12 jodon ki pasliyaan hoti hain jo dil aur lungs jaise vital organs ko protect karta hai.

original_english: Ribs are joined by flexible cartilage that allows the chest to expand and contract during breathing.
hinglish_roman: Pasliyaan flexible cartilage se judi hoti hain jo chest ko saas lete waqt pheelne aur sikodhne deta hai.

original_english: F.C. Steward demonstrated that even single phloem cells of carrot can regenerate a whole plant.
hinglish_roman: F.C. Steward ne dikhaya ki gajar ke phloem ki ek akeli cell bhi poora plant dobara bana sakti hai.

original_english: Totipotency is the ability of a mature cell to dedifferentiate, divide and develop into a complete new organism.
hinglish_roman: Totipotency ek mature cell ki woh ability hai jisme woh dedifferentiate hoke divide ho sakti hai aur ek poore naye organism mein develop ho sakti hai.

original_english: Agrobacterium tumefaciens causes crown gall disease, which leads to tumour-like swellings on plant stems.
hinglish_roman: Agrobacterium tumefaciens crown gall disease karta hai, jisme plant ke stems pe tumour-jaisi gaanthein bann jaati hain.

original_english: Stem cells in bone marrow are special cells that can divide and make new blood cells.
hinglish_roman: Bone marrow mein stem cells hoti hain jo special cells hain aur naye blood cells bana sakti hain.

original_english: Transpiration creates a pull in the xylem that helps water move up from roots to leaves.
hinglish_roman: Transpiration xylem mein ek pull create karta hai jo paani ko roots se leaves tak upar jaane mein help karta hai.

original_english: In unicellular organisms like amoeba, a single cell performs all functions of life.
hinglish_roman: Amoeba jaise unicellular organisms mein ek akeli cell hi zindagi ke saare kaam karti hai.

original_english: Sipra Guha Mukherjee and S.C. Maheshwari developed a complete plant through anther culture in a laboratory.
hinglish_roman: Sipra Guha Mukherjee aur S.C. Maheshwari ne laboratory mein anther culture se ek poora plant develop kiya.
